Open projects/design-studio/index.html\\n        ↓\\n2. Fill in Brand tab  (name, tagline, venue, social links)\\n        ↓\\n3. Pick Colors tab    (use a preset or dial in custom hex values)\\n        ↓\\n4. Choose Type tab    (heading font + body font)\\n        ↓\\n5. Toggle Sections    (choose which pages and home sections to include)\\n        ↓\\n6. Click \\\"⬇ Download Config\\\"\\n        ↓   saves brand-config.json to ~/Downloads/\\n7. In Claude Code, run:  /studio-build\\n        ↓\\n8. Site lands in  projects//\\n```\\n\\n## Panel Tabs\\n\\n### Brand\\n\\n| Field | Notes |\\n|-------|-------|\\n| Site Name | Full name — used in `` and footer |\\n| Short Name | Wordmark / logo text (e.g. `KUDT`) |\\n| Tagline | Hero subtitle and meta description fallback |\\n| Meta Description | SEO one-liner for search and social |\\n| Domain | Used in canonical URLs and JSON-LD |\\n| Language Code | `en`, `nl`, `de`, `fr`, `es` |\\n| Est. Year | Displayed in hero and footer |\\n| BPM | Flavor text in footer — any string works |\\n| Venue fields | Structured data for Google rich results |\\n| Social URLs | Instagram and Resident Advisor links |\\n| Ticket URL | CTA button in hero section |\\n| Form Backend | `formspree` (recommended) or `php` |\\n| Formspree Keys | Sign up at formspree.io for free keys |\\n\\n### Colors\\n\\nFive semantic color tokens:\\n\\n| Token | Role |\\n|-------|------|\\n| Background (Void) | Page background |\\n| Text / Cream | Body text and headings |\\n| Accent | Buttons, links, highlights |\\n| Surface | Nav, cards, footer bg |\\n| Muted | Subtitles, borders, metadata |\\n\\nSix built-in presets: **Void Dark**, **Dusk Purple**, **Deep Ocean**,\\n**Ember**, **Jade Night**, **Quartz** (light mode).\\n\\nYou can also type any hex value directly — the color picker and hex field\\nstay in sync.\\n\\n### Type\\n\\nChoose independent heading and body fonts from six Google Fonts options:\\n\\n- **Syne** — geometric, editorial\\n- **Unbounded** — wide, bold, techno\\n- **Playfair Display** — elegant serif\\n- **Space Grotesk** — clean, modern\\n- **Inter** — neutral, readable\\n- **DM Sans** — friendly grotesque\\n\\n### Sections\\n\\nToggle which pages and home sections to generate. Pages that are off are\\nremoved from the scaffold output and their nav links are cleaned up automatically.\\n\\n**Modules** — Optional features that can be toggled:\\n- **Calendar** — Event listing via RA embed or custom list\\n- **Gallery** — Flickr embed or image grid\\n- **Newsletter** — Email signup form\\n- **Checkout** — Stripe payment link or custom URL\\n- **Planner** — Booking request form\\n\\n### Content (NEW)\\n\\nAdd user-generated content to your site:\\n\\n| Section | Purpose |\\n|---------|---------|\\n| **Google Reviews** | Paste raw reviews from Google Maps or submit as JSON. The parser extracts author, rating, and text automatically. |\\n| **Images** | Hero background image URL (large, full-width), OG social share image, and gallery image URLs (one per line). |\\n\\nReviews appear on the home page with star ratings. Images are applied via background-image or `<img>` tags as appropriate.\\n\\n## brand-config.json Format\\n\\n```json\\n{\\n  \\\"site\\\": {\\n    \\\"name\\\": \\\"Club Nacht\\\",\\n \\\"nl\\\",\\n    \\\"locale\\\": \\\"nl_NL\\\",\\n    \\\"estYear\\\": \\\"2024\\\",\\n    \\\"bpm\\\": \\\"128 BPM\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"colors\\\": {\\n    \\\"void\\\": \\\"#0A0714\\\",\\n    \\\"cream\\\": \\\"#EDE8F5\\\",\\n    \\\"accent\\\": \\\"#9B5CF6\\\",\\n    \\\"surface\\\": \\\"#160D24\\\",\\n    \\\"muted\\\": \\\"#8070A0\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"fonts\\\": {\\n    \\\"heading\\\": \\\"newsletterKey\\\": \\\"...\\\",\\n    \\\"contactKey\\\": \\\"...\\\",\\n    \\\"recipientEmail\\\": \\\"\\\"\\n  },\\n  \\\"ticketUrl\\\": \\\"https://...\\\",\\n  \\\"sections\\\": {\\n    \\\"index\\\": true,\\n    \\\"events\\\": true,\\n    \\\"about\\\": true,\\n    \\\"gallery\\\": true,\\n    \\\"contact\\\": true,\\n    \\\"hero\\\": true,\\n    \\\"next-event\\\": true,\\n    \\\"newsletter\\\": true,\\n    \\\"instagram\\\": true,\\n    \\\"manifesto\\\": false,\\n    \\\"footer-social\\\": true,\\n    \\\"footer-nav\\\": true,\\n    \\\"footer-bpm\\\": true\\n  },\\n  \\\"reviews\\\": [\\n    {\\n      \\\"author\\\": \\\"Google User\\\",\\n      \\\"text\\\": \\\"Amazing night! Open `projects/<your-site>/index.html` in a browser\\n2. Fill in any remaining manual content slots\\n3. Run `/c3` for design polish (animations, responsive layout, hover states)\\n4. Run `/c4` for production hardening (CSP headers, performance audit)\\n5. Deploy to your host (see **Deployment Guide** section below)\\n\\n## Deployment Guide\\n\\n### Static hosting (recommended)\\n\\nYour generated site is a **static site** — just HTML, CSS, JS, and images. No server needed.\\n\\n**Recommended hosts:**\\n- **Vercel** — free tier, automatic deploys from git\\n- **Netlify** — free tier, drag-and-drop or git\\n- **GitHub Pages** — free, built into GitHub\\n- **Render** — free tier, easy setup\\n\\n**Steps:**\\n1. Create a git repo: `git init projects/<your-site>`\\n2. Connect to GitHub and push: `git add . && git commit && git push -u origin main`\\n3. Connect your repo to Vercel/Netlify in their dashboard\\n4. Site deploys automatically on each push\\n\\n### With PHP form handling\\n\\nIf you chose `\\\"backend\\\": \\\"php\\\"` in the Design Studio, you'll need a host with PHP support:\\n\\n- **Hostinger** — $3/mo, includes PHP + unlimited emails\\n- **Bluehost** — $2.95/mo intro, PHP + cPanel\\n- **DreamHost** — $2.59/mo, PHP + unlimited databases\\n\\nUpload the entire `projects/<your-site>/` folder via FTP or their file manager.\\n\\n### Custom domain\\n\\nPoint your domain registrar's DNS to your host:\\n- **Vercel**: Add CNAME record → vercel.com (see your project settings)\\n- **Netlify**: Add CNAME record → your-site.netlify.app\\n- **GitHub Pages**: Add CNAME file + DNS CNAME record\\n- **PHP host**: Add A record to host's IP address\\n\\n### Form emails\\n\\nIf using **Formspree**, emails go directly to your configured `recipientEmail`. No server config needed.\\n\\nIf using **PHP**, emails are sent from your server. Make sure:\\n1. Replace `xkokywzz` and `xrerjzlo` with real Formspree keys, OR\\n2. Keep the PHP backend and update `recipientEmail` to your email address\\n\\n### SSL/HTTPS\\n\\nModern hosts (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages) include **free SSL certificates** by default.\\n\\nFor PHP hosts, enable free SSL via your control panel (Let's Encrypt).\\n\\n## Tips\\n\\n- Use **Reset** to start over without refreshing the page\\n- The live preview updates instantly — no save needed\\n- The preview uses the same fonts and colors your generated site will use\\n- Font choices are injected as Google Fonts `<link>` tags at scaffold time\\n- You can re-run `/studio-build` after editing `brand-config.json` directly\\n\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"name\": \"scaffold.js\",\n    \"group\": \"Studio App\",\n    \"path\": \"scripts/site-template/scaffold.js\",\n    \"content\": \"'use strict';\\n\\nconst fs = require('fs');\\nconst path = require('path');\\n\\nconst TEMPLATE_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../templates/queer-nightclub');\\n\\nfunction usage() {\\n  console.error('Usage: node scaffold.js --config <brand.config.json> --out <output-dir>');\\n  process.exit(1);\\n}\\n\\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\\n  const args = {};\\n  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {\\n    if (argv[i] === '--config') args.config = argv[++i];\\n    if (argv[i] === '--out') args.out = argv[++i];\\n  }\\n  return args;\\n}\\n\\nfunction sectionFlag(cfg, key) {\\n  return cfg.sections && cfg.sections[key] === false ? ImageFont.load_default() if system fonts are unavailable.\\\"\\n)\\n(ROOT / \\\"_og_image_code.py\\\").write_text(og_code, encoding=\\\"utf-8\\\")\\nog_img = run_draw_code(og_code)\\nog_img.save(ROOT \"commands/studio-build.md\",\n    \"content\": \"---\\ndescription: Build a site from a brand-config.json downloaded from the Design Studio\\nargument-hint: \\\"[path/to/brand-config.json]\\\"\\n---\\n\\n# /studio-build — Build Site from Design Studio Config\\n\\nTakes a `brand-config.json` produced by `projects/design-studio/index.html` and\\nscaffolds a complete static website into `projects//`.\\n\\n## When to Use\\n\\n- After downloading a config from the Design Studio\\n- Re-building / updating an existing project after changing brand values\\n- Automating the design → site pipeline end-to-end\\n\\n## Steps\\n\\n### 1 — Locate brand-config.json\\n\\nIf the user passed a path argument, use it. Otherwise look in these locations (first match wins):\\n\\n1. `./brand-config.json`\\n2. `~/Downloads/brand-config.json`\\n3. Ask the user for the path\\n\\nRead and parse the file. Validate it has at minimum: `site.name`, `site.short`, `colors`, `venue`.\\n\\n### 2 — Derive project name\\n\\n```js\\nconst projectName = config.site.name\\n  .toLowerCase().replace(/\\\\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '');\\n```\\n\\nConfirm the output directory with the user: `projects//`\\n\\n### 3 — Write brand.config.json to project dir\\n\\n```bash\\nmkdir -p projects/\\ncp  projects//brand.config.json\\n```\\n\\n### 4 — Scaffold the site\\n\\n```bash\\nnode scripts/site-template/scaffold.js \\\\\\n  --config projects//brand.config.json \\\\\\n  --out projects/\\n```\\n\\n### 5 — Font tokens (handled automatically by scaffold)\\n\\nThe Design Studio config includes a `fonts` object (`{ heading, body }`).\\n`scaffold.js` maps these to `{{FONT_HEADING}}`, `{{FONT_BODY}}`, and\\n`{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}` — the Google Fonts `` tag is injected into every\\npage automatically. No extra step needed.\\n\\nIf `cfg.fonts` is absent (legacy configs), the tokens fall back to\\n`system-ui, sans-serif` and the Google Fonts link is omitted.\\n\\n### 6 — Apply section flags\\n\\nThe Design Studio config includes a `sections` map. Pages whose flag is `false` should be\\nremoved from the output directory and their nav links cleaned up:\\n\\n```js\\nconst pages = { index:'index.html', events:'events.html', about:'about.html', gallery:'gallery.html', contact:'contact.html' };\\nfor (const [key, file] of Object.entries(pages)) {\\n  if (!config.sections?.[key]) {\\n    // remove file, remove its  from nav in remaining pages\\n  }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 7 — Validate output\\n\\n```bash\\nnode scripts/site-template/validate.js --dir projects/\\n```\\n\\nFix any remaining `{{TOKEN}}` placeholders before continuing.\\n\\n### 8 — Generate brand assets\\n\\n```bash\\ncd projects/ && python generate-assets.py\\n```\\n\\nProduces `og-image.png`, `favicon.ico`, and `apple-touch-icon.png` from brand colors.\\n\\n### 9 — Report\\n\\nTell the user:\\n\\n- Output directory: `projects//`\\n- Pages generated (list)\\n- Any manual content slots still needed:\\n  - Event names, dates, ticket URLs (`index.html`, `events.html`)\\n  - Team bios (`about.html`)\\n  - Gallery / Flickr URL (`gallery.html`)\\n  - Google Maps iframe (`contact.html`)\\n  - Formspree keys if placeholders remain\\n- Next step: open `projects//index.html` in a browser to review\\n\\n### 10 — Offer session handoff\\n\\nAfter the report, ask the user:\\n\\n> \\\"Want me to save session state so you can pick this up in a new session?\\n> Just say yes and I'll run `/save-session` with everything pre-filled.\\\"\\n\\nIf the user agrees, invoke `/save-session` with context pre-populated:\\n\\n- **What's being built**: `projects//` — static site scaffolded from Design Studio config\\n- **Current state**: Scaffold complete. Re-run `/studio-build projects//brand.config.json` to rebuild after any config edits.\\n\\nIn a future session, `/resume-session` will load this state and Claude will brief the project before the user types anything.\\n\\n### 11 — Offer chelp next step\\n\\nAfter the session handoff offer, prompt:\\n\\n> Your site is ready at `projects//index.html`.\\n>\\n> What next?\\n> - `/c3` — Design polish (animations, responsive breakpoints, hover states, micro-interactions)\\n> - `/c4` — Production hardening (security headers, CSP, performance audit, PR)\\n> - `/c5` — Cleanup and docs sync (unused files, README, deployment guide)\\n> - Done for now\\n\\nRun the chosen chain with the project slug and `projects//` as the working context.\\nPass the `brand.config.json` path so the chain has access to brand values without re-reading the scaffold.\\n\\n## Usage Examples\\n\\n```\\n/studio-build\\n/studio-build ~/Downloads/brand-config.json\\n/studio-build projects/my-club/brand-config.json\\n```\\n\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"name\": \"site-init.md\",\n    \"group\": \"Commands & Skills\",\n    \"path\": \"commands/site-init.md\",\n    \"content\": \"---\\ndescription: Scaffold a new site from the queer-nightclub template using a brand config\\nargument-hint: \\\"[project-name] [--config path/to/brand.config.json]\\\"\\n---\\n\\n# site-init — Scaffold a New Site from Template\\n\\nGenerates a complete static website by applying a `brand.config.json` to the\\n`templates/queer-nightclub/` template.     "content": "# Design Studio — Usage Guide\n\nA browser-based brand builder that generates a `brand-config.json` you can feed\ndirectly into the site scaffolder via `/studio-build`.\n\n## Quick Start\n\n```\nopen projects/design-studio/index.html   # macOS\nxdg-open projects/design-studio/index.html  # Linux\nstart projects/design-studio/index.html  # Windows\n```\n\nOr open the file in any browser — no server needed.\n\n## Workflow\n\n```\n1. Open projects/design-studio/index.html\n        ↓\n2. Fill in Brand tab  (name, tagline, venue, social links)\n        ↓\n3. Pick Colors tab    (use a preset or dial in custom hex values)\n        ↓\n4. Choose Type tab    (heading font + body font)\n        ↓\n5. Toggle Sections    (choose which pages and home sections to include)\n        ↓\n6. Click \"⬇ Download Config\"\n        ↓   saves brand-config.json to ~/Downloads/\n7. In Claude Code, run:  /studio-build\n        ↓\n8. Site lands in  projects//\n```\n\n## Panel Tabs\n\n### Brand\n\n| Field | Notes |\n|-------|-------|\n| Site Name | Full name — used in `` and footer |\n| Short Name | Wordmark / logo text (e.g. `KUDT`) |\n| Tagline | Hero subtitle and meta description fallback |\n| Meta Description | SEO one-liner for search and social |\n| Domain | Used in canonical URLs and JSON-LD |\n| Language Code | `en`, `nl`, `de`, `fr`, `es` |\n| Est. Year | Displayed in hero and footer |\n| BPM | Flavor text in footer — any string works |\n| Venue fields | Structured data for Google rich results |\n| Social URLs | Instagram and Resident Advisor links |\n| Ticket URL | CTA button in hero section |\n| Form Backend | `formspree` (recommended) or `php` |\n| Formspree Keys | Sign up at formspree.io for free keys |\n\n### Colors\n\nFive semantic color tokens:\n\n| Token | Role |\n|-------|------|\n| Background (Void) | Page background |\n| Text / Cream | Body text and headings |\n| Accent | Buttons, links, highlights |\n| Surface | Nav, cards, footer bg |\n| Muted | Subtitles, borders, metadata |\n\nSix built-in presets: **Void Dark**, **Dusk Purple**, **Deep Ocean**,\n**Ember**, **Jade Night**, **Quartz** (light mode).\n\nYou can also type any hex value directly — the color picker and hex field\nstay in sync.\n\n### Type\n\nChoose independent heading and body fonts from six Google Fonts options:\n\n- **Syne** — geometric, editorial\n- **Unbounded** — wide, bold, techno\n- **Playfair Display** — elegant serif\n- **Space Grotesk** — clean, modern\n- **Inter** — neutral, readable\n- **DM Sans** — friendly grotesque\n\n### Sections\n\nToggle which pages and home sections to generate. Pages that are off are\nremoved from the scaffold output and their nav links are cleaned up automatically.\n\n**Modules** — Optional features that can be toggled:\n- **Calendar** — Event listing via RA embed or custom list\n- **Gallery** — Flickr embed or image grid\n- **Newsletter** — Email signup form\n- **Checkout** — Stripe payment link or custom URL\n- **Planner** — Booking request form\n\n### Content (NEW)\n\nAdd user-generated content to your site:\n\n| Section | Purpose |\n|---------|---------|\n| **Google Reviews** | Paste raw reviews from Google Maps or submit as JSON. The parser extracts author, rating, and text automatically. |\n| **Images** | Hero background image URL (large, full-width), OG social share image, and gallery image URLs (one per line). |\n\nReviews appear on the home page with star ratings. Images are applied via background-image or `<img>` tags as appropriate.\n\n## brand-config.json Format\n\n```json\n{\n  \"site\": {\n    \"name\": \"Club Nacht\",\n    \"short\": \"NACHT\",\n    \"domain\": \"clubnacht.nl\",\n    \"tagline\": \"Underground · Electronic · Queer\",\n    \"description\": \"...\",\n    \"lang\": \"nl\",\n    \"locale\": \"nl_NL\",\n    \"estYear\": \"2024\",\n    \"bpm\": \"128 BPM\"\n  },\n  \"colors\": {\n    \"void\": \"#0A0714\",\n    \"cream\": \"#EDE8F5\",\n    \"accent\": \"#9B5CF6\",\n    \"surface\": \"#160D24\",\n    \"muted\": \"#8070A0\"\n  },\n  \"fonts\": {\n    \"heading\": \"Syne\",\n    \"body\": \"Inter\"\n  },\n  \"venue\": {\n    \"name\": \"Shelter Amsterdam\",\n    \"city\": \"Amsterdam\",\n    \"region\": \"Noord-Holland\",\n    \"country\": \"NL\"\n  },\n  \"social\": {\n    \"instagram\": \"https://instagram.com/yourclub\",\n    \"ra\": \"https://ra.co/clubs/yourclub\",\n    \"facebook\": \"https://facebook.com/yourclub\",\n    \"tiktok\": \"https://tiktok.com/@yourclub\",\n    \"spotify\": \"https://open.spotify.com/user/yourclub\",\n    \"youtube\": \"https://youtube.com/@yourclub\"\n  },\n  \"forms\": {\n    \"backend\": \"formspree\",\n    \"newsletterKey\": \"...\",\n    \"contactKey\": \"...\",\n    \"recipientEmail\": \"\"\n  },\n  \"ticketUrl\": \"https://...\",\n  \"sections\": {\n    \"index\": true,\n    \"events\": true,\n    \"about\": true,\n    \"gallery\": true,\n    \"contact\": true,\n    \"hero\": true,\n    \"next-event\": true,\n    \"newsletter\": true,\n    \"instagram\": true,\n    \"manifesto\": false,\n    \"footer-social\": true,\n    \"footer-nav\": true,\n    \"footer-bpm\": true\n  },\n  \"reviews\": [\n    {\n      \"author\": \"Google User\",\n      \"text\": \"Amazing night! Great music and vibe.\",\n      \"rating\": 5,\n      \"source\": \"google\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"images\": {\n    \"hero\": \"https://...\",\n    \"og\": \"https://...\",\n    \"gallery\": [\"https://...\", \"https://...\"]\n  },\n  \"modules\": {\n    \"calendar\": {\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"type\": \"ra-embed\"\n    },\n    \"checkout\": {\n      \"enabled\": false,\n      \"url\": \"https://buy.stripe.com/...\",\n      \"provider\": \"stripe-link\"\n    },\n    \"planner\": {\n      \"enabled\": false\n    },\n    \"gallery\": {\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"type\": \"flickr\"\n    },\n    \"newsletter\": {\n      \"enabled\": true\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## After `/studio-build`\n\nThe `/studio-build` command scaffolds your site and reports which content slots still need manual editing:\n\n### Automated slots (pre-filled from config)\n- ✅ Reviews — injected from `reviews[]`\n- ✅ Social links — drawn from `social.*` \n- ✅ Hero image — applied from `images.hero`\n- ✅ Modules — calendar, checkout, planner visibility based on `modules.*`\n\n### Manual slots (still need editing)\n- **Event data** — event names, dates, ticket links in `index.html` and `events.html`\n- **Team bios** — names, roles, photos in `about.html`\n- **Gallery** — Flickr album URL (if module enabled) in `gallery.html`\n- **Map embed** — Google Maps iframe in `contact.html` (if contact form enabled)\n- **Formspree keys** — replace placeholder keys with your real account keys from formspree.io\n\n### Next steps\n\n1. Open `projects/<your-site>/index.html` in a browser\n2. Fill in any remaining manual content slots\n3. Run `/c3` for design polish (animations, responsive layout, hover states)\n4. Run `/c4` for production hardening (CSP headers, performance audit)\n5. Deploy to your host (see **Deployment Guide** section below)\n\n## Deployment Guide\n\n### Static hosting (recommended)\n\nYour generated site is a **static site** — just HTML, CSS, JS, and images. No server needed.\n\n**Recommended hosts:**\n- **Vercel** — free tier, automatic deploys from git\n- **Netlify** — free tier, drag-and-drop or git\n- **GitHub Pages** — free, built into GitHub\n- **Render** — free tier, easy setup\n\n**Steps:**\n1. Create a git repo: `git init projects/<your-site>`\n2. Connect to GitHub and push: `git add . && git commit && git push -u origin main`\n3. Connect your repo to Vercel/Netlify in their dashboard\n4. Site deploys automatically on each push\n\n### With PHP form handling\n\nIf you chose `\"backend\": \"php\"` in the Design Studio, you'll need a host with PHP support:\n\n- **Hostinger** — $3/mo, includes PHP + unlimited emails\n- **Bluehost** — $2.95/mo intro, PHP + cPanel\n- **DreamHost** — $2.59/mo, PHP + unlimited databases\n\nUpload the entire `projects/<your-site>/` folder via FTP or their file manager.\n\n### Custom domain\n\nPoint your domain registrar's DNS to your host:\n- **Vercel**: Add CNAME record → vercel.com (see your project settings)\n- **Netlify**: Add CNAME record → your-site.netlify.app\n- **GitHub Pages**: Add CNAME file + DNS CNAME record\n- **PHP host**: Add A record to host's IP address\n\n### Form emails\n\nIf using **Formspree**, emails go directly to your configured `recipientEmail`. No server config needed.\n\nIf using **PHP**, emails are sent from your server. Make sure:\n1. Replace `xkokywzz` and `xrerjzlo` with real Formspree keys, OR\n2. Keep the PHP backend and update `recipientEmail` to your email address\n\n### SSL/HTTPS\n\nModern hosts (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages) include **free SSL certificates** by default.\n\nFor PHP hosts, enable free SSL via your control panel (Let's Encrypt).\n\n## Tips\n\n- Use **Reset** to start over without refreshing the page\n- The live preview updates instantly — no save needed\n- The preview uses the same fonts and colors your generated site will use\n- Font choices are injected as Google Fonts `<link>` tags at scaffold time\n- You can re-run `/studio-build` after editing `brand-config.json` directly\n"

families.push(fonts.heading.replace(/ /g, '+') + ':wght@400;700;900');\n  if (fonts.body && fonts.body !== fonts.heading) families.push(fonts.body.replace(/ /g, '+') + ':wght@400;700');\n  const qs = '{{COLOR_ACCENT}}': cfg.colors.accent,\n    '{{COLOR_SURFACE}}': cfg.colors.surface,\n    '{{COLOR_MUTED}}': cfg.colors.muted,\n\n    // Venue\n    '{{VENUE_NAME}}': cfg.venue.name,\n '',\n    '{{SOCIAL_RA}}': social.ra || '',\n    // Social (extended)\n    '{{SOCIAL_FACEBOOK}}': social.facebook || '',\n    '{{SOCIAL_TIKTOK}}': social.tiktok || '',\n    '{{SOCIAL_SPOTIFY}}': social.spotify || '',\n    '{{SOCIAL_YOUTUBE}}': social.youtube || '',\n\n    // Forms\n    '{{FORMS_BACKEND}}': cfg.forms.backend,\n    '{{FORMSPREE_NEWSLETTER}}': cfg.forms.newsletterKey || '',\n    '{{FORMSPREE_CONTACT}}': cfg.forms.contactKey || '',\n    '{{FORMS_RECIPIENT_EMAIL}}': cfg.forms.recipientEmail || '',\n    '{{TICKET_URL}}': cfg.ticketUrl || '',\n\n    // Fonts\n    '{{FONT_HEADING}}': (cfg.fonts && cfg.fonts.heading) || 'system-ui, sans-serif',\n    '{{FONT_BODY}}': (cfg.fonts && cfg.fonts.body) || 'system-ui, sans-serif',\n    '{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}': googleFontsLink(cfg.fonts),\n\n    // Section visibility (CSS style value)\n    '{{SECTION_EVENTS}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'events'),\n    '{{SECTION_ABOUT}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'about'),\n    '{{SECTION_GALLERY}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'gallery'),\n    '{{SECTION_CONTACT}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'contact'),\n    '{{SECTION_HERO}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'hero'),\n    '{{SECTION_NEXT_EVENT}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'next-event'),\n    '{{SECTION_NEWSLETTER}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'newsletter'),\n    '{{SECTION_INSTAGRAM}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'instagram'),\n    '{{SECTION_MANIFESTO}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'manifesto'),\n    '{{FOOTER_SOCIAL}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'footer-social'),\n    '{{FOOTER_NAV}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'footer-nav'),\n    '{{FOOTER_BPM}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'footer-bpm'),\n    // Nav link visibility\n    '{{NAV_EVENTS}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'events'),\n    '{{NAV_ABOUT}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'about'),\n    '{{NAV_GALLERY}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'gallery'),\n    '{{NAV_CONTACT}}': sectionFlag(cfg, 'contact'),\n\n    // Reviews (escape </script> to prevent template injection)\n    '{{REVIEWS_JSON}}': JSON.stringify(reviews).replace(/<\\/script>/gi, '<\\\\/script>'),\n\n    // Images\n    '{{IMAGE_HERO}}': images.hero || '',\n    '{{IMAGE_OG}}': images.og || '',\n    '{{IMAGE_GALLERY_LIST}}': (images.gallery || []).join(','),\n\n    // Modules\n    '{{MODULE_CALENDAR}}': moduleFlag(cfg, 'calendar'),\n    '{{MODULE_CALENDAR_TYPE}}': (modules.calendar && modules.calendar.type) || 'ra-embed',\n    '{{MODULE_CHECKOUT}}': moduleFlag(cfg, && modules.gallery.type) || 'flickr',\n    '{{MODULE_NEWSLETTER}}': moduleFlag(cfg, 'newsletter') || '', // newsletter defaults on\n\n    // SEO (Phase 13.6)\n    '{{SEO_TITLE}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.title) || cfg.site.name,\n    '{{SEO_DESCRIPTION}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.description) || cfg.site.description,\n    '{{SEO_OG_TITLE}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.ogTitle) || cfg.site.name,\n    '{{SEO_KEYWORDS}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.keywords) || '',\n\n    // Layout variants (C2)\n    '{{LAYOUT_HERO}}':       (cfg.layout && cfg.layout.hero)      || 'full-bleed',\n    '{{LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT}}': (cfg.layout && cfg.layout.nextEvent) || 'card',\n    '{{LAYOUT_FOOTER}}':     (cfg.layout && cfg.layout.footer)    || 'standard',\n  };\n}\n\nfunction applyTokens(content, tokenMap) {\n  let result = content;\n  for (const [token, value] of Object.entries(tokenMap)) {\n    result = result.split(token).join(value);\n  }\n  return result;\n}\n\nfunction walkFiles(dir, base = dir, acc = []) {\n  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {\n    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);\n    if (entry.isDirectory()) {\n      walkFiles(full, base, acc);\n    } else {\n      acc.push(path.relative(base, full));\n    }\n  }\n  return acc;\n}\n\nconst BINARY_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['.ico', '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.webp', '.woff', '.woff2', '.ttf', '.eot', '.svg']);\n\nfunction isBinary(filePath) {\n  return BINARY_EXTENSIONS.has(path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase());\n}\n\nfunction validateConfig(cfg) {\n  const required = ['site.name', 'site.domain', 'colors.accent', 'venue.city', 'forms.backend'];\n  const missing = required.filter(p => {\n    const [a, b] = p.split('.');\n    return !cfg[a] || !cfg[a][b];\n  });\n  if (missing.length) {\n    console.error(`[scaffold] Config missing required fields: ${missing.join(', ')}`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction scaffold(configPath, outDir) {\n  if (!fs.existsSync(configPath)) {\n    console.error('[scaffold] Config file not found');\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  let cfg;\n  try {\n    cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8'));\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(`[scaffold] Invalid JSON in config: ${e.message}`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  validateConfig(cfg);\n  const tokenMap = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n\n  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\n  const files = walkFiles(TEMPLATE_DIR);\n  let count = 0;\n\n  // Pages that can be disabled via sections config\n  const PAGE_SECTION_MAP = {\n    'events.html': 'events',\n    'about.html': 'about',\n    'gallery.html': 'gallery',\n    'contact.html': 'contact',\n  };\n\n  for (const rel of files) {\n    // Skip brand.config.json itself — user count++;\n  }\n\n  // Copy brand.config.json into output so the site remembers its config\n  fs.copyFileSync(configPath, path.join(outDir, 'brand.config.json'));\n\n  console.log(`[scaffold] ${count}     "content": "'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst path = require('path');\n\nfunction usage() {\n  console.error('Usage: node validate.js --dir <output-dir> [--config <brand.config.json>]');\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\n  const args = {};\n  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {\n    if (argv[i] === '--dir') args.dir = argv[++i];\n    if (argv[i] === '--config') args.config = argv[++i];\n  }\n  return args;\n}\n\nconst TEXT_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['.html', '.css', '.js', '.xml', '.txt', '.md', '.json', '.py', '.htaccess', '.php']);\n\nfunction isTextFile(filePath) {\n  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();\n  if (ext === '') {\n    // e.g. .htaccess\n    return path.basename(filePath).startsWith('.');\n  }\n  return TEXT_EXTENSIONS.has(ext);\n}\n\nfunction walkFiles(dir, base = dir, acc = []) {\n  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {\n    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);\n    if (entry.isDirectory()) {\n      walkFiles(full, base, acc);\n    } else {\n      acc.push(path.relative(base, full));\n    }\n  }\n  return acc;\n}\n\nfunction validate(outDir, configPath) {\n  if (!fs.existsSync(outDir)) {\n    console.error(`[validate] Output dir not found: ${outDir}`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  const errors = [];\n  const warnings = [];\n  const files = walkFiles(outDir);\n\n  for (const rel of files) {\n    const full = path.join(outDir, rel);\n    if (!isTextFile(rel)) continue;\n\n    const lines = fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8').split('\\n');\n    lines.forEach((line, i) => {\n      // Check for unsubstituted tokens\n      const tokenMatch = line.match(/\\{\\{[A-Z_]+\\}\\}/g);\n      if (tokenMatch) {\n        for (const token of tokenMatch) {\n          errors.push(`${rel}:${i + 1} — unsubstituted token: ${token}`);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // If a config was provided, also warn about any source brand strings still in output\n  if (configPath && fs.existsSync(configPath)) {\n    let cfg;\n    try {\n      cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8'));\n    } catch (_) {\n      cfg = null;\n    }\n\n    if (cfg) {\n      // Build a list of source brand values to warn on (skip generic ones like colors)\n      const sourceStrings = [\n        { value: cfg.site.domain, label: 'source domain' },\n        { value: cfg.site.name, label: 'source site name' },\n        { value: cfg.site.short, label: 'source short name' },\n      ].filter(s => s.value && s.value.length > 3);\n\n      const templateConfigPath = path.join(outDir, 'brand.config.json');\n      let outputCfg = null;\n      if (fs.existsSync(templateConfigPath)) {\n        try { outputCfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(templateConfigPath, 'utf8')); } catch (_) {}\n      }\n\n      // Only warn if the output brand differs from the source (i.e. user actually renamed)\n      if (outputCfg && outputCfg.site && outputCfg.site.domain !== cfg.site.domain) {\n        for (const { value, label } of sourceStrings) {\n          for (const rel of files) {\n            if (rel === 'brand.config.json') continue;\n            const full = path.join(outDir, rel);\n            if (!isTextFile(rel)) continue;\n            const content = fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8');\n            if (content.includes(value)) {\n              warnings.push(`${rel} — still contains ${label}: \"${value}\"`);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (warnings.length) {\n    console.warn('[validate] Warnings:');\n    warnings.forEach(w => console.warn(`  ⚠  ${w}`));\n  }\n\n  if (errors.length) {\n    console.error('[validate] Errors:');\n    errors.forEach(e => console.error(`  ✗  ${e}`));\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  console.log(`[validate] ✓ ${files.length} files checked — no unsubstituted tokens`);\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) {\n  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));\n  if (!args.dir) usage();\n  validate(path.resolve(args.dir), args.config ? path.resolve(args.config) : null);\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { validate };\n"

    "content": "'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst os = require('os');\nconst path = require('path');\nconst { scaffold, buildTokenMap, applyTokens } = require('../../scripts/site-template/scaffold');\nconst { validate } = require('../../scripts/site-template/validate');\n\nconst TEMPLATE_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../templates/queer-nightclub');\nconst EXAMPLE_CONFIG = path.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, 'brand.config.json');\n\nlet passed = 0;\nlet failed = 0;\n\nfunction test(name, fn) {\n  try {\n    fn();\n    console.log(`  ✓ ${name}`);\n    passed++;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(`  ✗ ${name}`);\n    console.error(`    ${e.message}`);\n    failed++;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction assert(cond, msg) {\n  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg || 'assertion failed');\n}\n\nfunction tmpDir() {\n  return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ecc-scaffold-'));\n}\n\nfunction cleanTmp(dir) {\n  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n}\n\n// ── buildTokenMap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== buildTokenMap ===\\n');\n\ntest('produces expected tokens from config', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{SITE_NAME}}'] === cfg.site.name, 'SITE_NAME mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{SITE_DOMAIN}}'] === cfg.site.domain, 'SITE_DOMAIN mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{COLOR_ACCENT}}'] === cfg.colors.accent, 'COLOR_ACCENT mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{VENUE_CITY}}'] === cfg.venue.city, 'VENUE_CITY mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM}}'] === cfg.social.instagram, 'SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{FORMS_BACKEND}}'] === cfg.forms.backend, 'FORMS_BACKEND mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{TICKET_URL}}'] === cfg.ticketUrl, 'TICKET_URL mismatch');\n});\n\ntest('all tokens map to strings (required tokens non-empty)', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  const required = ['{{SITE_NAME}}', '{{SITE_DOMAIN}}', '{{COLOR_ACCENT}}', '{{VENUE_CITY}}', '{{FORMS_BACKEND}}'];\n  for (const [token, value] of Object.entries(map)) {\n    assert(typeof value === 'string', `${token} is not a string`);\n  }\n  for (const token of required) {\n    assert(map[token] && map[token].length > 0, `required ${token} maps to empty string`);\n  }\n});\n\n// ── applyTokens ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== applyTokens ===\\n');\n\ntest('substitutes a single token', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('Hello {{SITE_NAME}}!', { '{{SITE_NAME}}': 'Club Test' });\n  assert(result === 'Hello Club Test!', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('substitutes multiple occurrences of the same token', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('{{SITE_NAME}} / {{SITE_NAME}}', { '{{SITE_NAME}}': 'X' });\n  assert(result === 'X / X', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('substitutes multiple different tokens', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('{{A}} and {{B}}', { '{{A}}': 'foo', '{{B}}': 'bar' });\n  assert(result === 'foo and bar', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('returns content unchanged when no tokens present', ()     "content": "'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst os = require('os');\nconst path = require('path');\nconst { scaffold } = require('../../scripts/site-template/scaffold');\nconst { validate } = require('../../scripts/site-template/validate');\n\nconst TEMPLATE_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../templates/queer-nightclub');\nconst EXAMPLE_CONFIG = path.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, 'brand.config.json');\n\nlet passed = 0;\nlet failed = 0;\n\nfunction test(name, fn) {\n  try {\n    fn();\n    console.log(`  ✓ ${name}`);\n    passed++;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(`  ✗ ${name}`);\n    console.error(`    ${e.message}`);\n    failed++;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction assert(cond, msg) {\n  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg || 'assertion failed');\n}\n\nfunction tmpDir() {\n  return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ecc-validate-'));\n}\n\nfunction cleanTmp(dir) {\n  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n}\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== validate ===\\n');\n\ntest('validate passes on clean scaffold output', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    let caught = null;\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (e) { caught = e; }\n    assert(!caught, `validate threw: ${caught}`);\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate catches {{LEFTOVER_TOKEN}} in HTML and calls process.exit', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const idx = path.join(out, 'index.html');\n    fs.appendFileSync(idx, '\\n<!-- {{LEFTOVER_TOKEN}} -->');\n    let exited = false;\n    const origExit = process.exit;\n    process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (_) {}\n    process.exit = origExit;\n    assert(exited, 'validate did not call process.exit on leftover token');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate warns when original brand string remains after rename', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  const altCfgPath = path.join(out, 'alt-brand.json');\n  try {\n    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });\n    // Build a renamed config so the output brand differs from source\n    const base = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    base.site.name = 'New Club';\n    base.site.short = 'NEW';\n    base.site.domain = 'newclub.nl';\n    fs.writeFileSync(altCfgPath, JSON.stringify(base), 'utf8');\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out); // scaffold with ORIGINAL config — source brand strings will appear\n    // validate against alt config — domain differs, should trigger brand string check\n    let warnFired = false;\n    const origWarn = console.warn;\n    console.warn = (msg) => { if (msg && msg.includes('source')) warnFired = true; origWarn(msg); };\n    let caught = null;\n    try { validate(out, altCfgPath); } catch (e) { caught = e; }\n    console.warn = origWarn;\n    // Should either warn or pass — main assertion is no crash\n    assert(!caught || caught.message === 'exit called', `unexpected error: ${caught}`);\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate skips binary files (.ico, .png)', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    // Inject a fake token into a binary-extension file — validate should not catch it\n    const fake = path.join(out, 'fake.ico');\n    fs.writeFileSync(fake, '{{FAKE_TOKEN}}');\n    let exited = false;\n    const origExit = process.exit;\n    process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (_) {}\n    process.exit = origExit;\n    assert(!exited, 'validate scanned binary .ico file and exited unexpectedly');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate handles missing output directory by calling process.exit', () => {\n  let exited = false;\n  const origExit = process.exit;\n  process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n  try { validate('/nonexistent/output-dir', null); } catch (_) {}\n  process.exit = origExit;\n  assert(exited, 'validate did not call process.exit for missing output dir');\n});\n\n// ── Results ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log(`\\n=== Test Results ===`);\nconsole.log(`Passed: ${passed}`);\nconsole.log(`Failed: ${failed}`);\nconsole.log(`Total:  ${passed + failed}`);\n\nif (failed > 0) process.exit(1);\n"

\n        
2023

Sep 2024

2025

'';\nif (str_contains($ct, 'application/json')) {\n    $body = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];\n} else {\n    $body = $_POST;\n}\n\n$type = sanitize($body['_type'] ?? 'newsletter');\n\n// ── Honeypot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif (!empty($body['_gotcha'])) {\n    json_out(200, ['ok' => true]); // silent absorb\n}\n\n// ── Newsletter signup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif ($type === 'newsletter') {\n    $email = sanitize($body['email'] ?? '');\n    if (!validate_email($email)) {\n        json_out(422, ['error' => 'invalid email']);\n    }\n    $ip_key = 'nl_' . ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? 'x');\n    if (!rate_check($ip_key)) {\n        json_out(429, ['error' => 'too many requests']);\n    }\n\n    $to      = RECIPIENT;\n    $subject = SITE_NAME . ' — New newsletter signup';\n    $message = \"New newsletter signup from \" . SITE_DOMAIN . \"\\n\\nEmail: {$email}\\nTime: \" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s T');\n    $headers = \"From: no-reply@\" . SITE_DOMAIN . \"\\r\\nReply-To: {$email}\\r\\nX-Mailer: PHP/\" . phpversion();\n\n    $sent = mail($to, $subject, $message, $headers);\n    json_out($sent ? 200 : 500, $sent ? ['ok' => true] : ['error' => 'mail failed']);\n}\n\n// ── Contact / booking form ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif ($type === 'contact') {\n    $name    = sanitize($body['name']    ?? '');\n    $email   = sanitize($body['email']   ?? '');\n    $subject = sanitize($body['subject'] ?? 'Enquiry');\n    $message = sanitize($body['message'] ?? '');\n\n    if (!$name || !validate_email($email) || !$message) {\n        json_out(422, ['error' => 'missing required fields']);\n    }\n    if (strlen($message) > 4000) {\n        json_out(422, ['error' => 'message too long']);\n    }\n\n    $ip_key = 'contact_' . ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? 'x');\n    if (!rate_check($ip_key)) {\n        json_out(429, ['error' => 'too many requests']);\n    }\n\n    $to       = RECIPIENT;\n    $sub      = SITE_NAME . \" — {$subject} from {$name}\";\n    $body_txt = \"Name: {$name}\\nEmail: {$email}\\nSubject: {$subject}\\n\\n{$message}\\n\\nSent from: \" . SITE_DOMAIN;\n    $headers  = \"From: no-reply@\" . SITE_DOMAIN . \"\\r\\nReply-To: {$email}\\r\\nX-Mailer: PHP/\" . phpversion();\n\n    $sent = mail($to, $sub, $body_txt, $headers);\n    json_out($sent ? 200 : 500, $sent ?     "name": "template/generate-assets.py",
    "group": "Template",
    "path": "templates/queer-nightclub/generate-assets.py",
    "content": "\"\"\"\ngenerate-assets.py\nGenerates og-image.png, favicon.ico, and apple-touch-icon.png for {{SITE_NAME}}.\n\nRequirements:\n    pip install anthropic Pillow\n\nUsage:\n    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... python generate-assets.py\n\"\"\"\n\nimport io\nimport os\nimport re\nimport sys\nimport textwrap\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport anthropic\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).parent\nAPI_KEY = os.environ.get(\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\")\nif not API_KEY:\n    sys.exit(\"Error: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is not set.\")\n\nclient = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=API_KEY)\n\nBRAND = {\n    \"bg\": \"#0a0a0a\",\n    \"text\": \"{{COLOR_CREAM}}\",\n    \"accent\": \"{{COLOR_ACCENT}}\",\n    \"muted\": \"{{COLOR_MUTED}}\",\n}\n\n\ndef ask_claude_for_pillow_code(description: str) -> str:\n    prompt = textwrap.dedent(f\"\"\"\n        Write a Python function called `draw_image` that returns a `PIL.Image.Image` object.\n\n        The function must:\n        - Use only `PIL.Image`, `PIL.ImageDraw`, and `PIL.ImageFont` (already imported)\n        - Draw: {description}\n        - Return the finished Image object\n\n        Brand colors: background {BRAND['bg']}, text/shapes {BRAND['text']}, accent {BRAND['accent']}.\n\n        Output ONLY the raw Python function — no markdown fences, no imports, no example calls.\n    \"\"\").strip()\n\n    message = client.messages.create(\n        model=\"claude-sonnet-4-6\",\n        max_tokens=2048,\n        messages=[{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": prompt}],\n    )\n    code = message.content[0].text.strip()\n    # Strip accidental markdown fences\n    code = re.sub(r\"^```[a-z]*\\n?\", \"\", code)\n    code = re.sub(r\"\\n?```$\", \"\", code)\n    return code.strip()\n\n\ndef run_draw_code(code: str) -> Image.Image:\n    import PIL\n    import PIL.Image\n    import PIL.ImageDraw\n    import PIL.ImageFont\n    namespace = {\n        \"PIL\": PIL,\n        \"Image\": Image,\n        \"ImageDraw\": ImageDraw,\n        \"ImageFont\": ImageFont,\n    }\n    exec(code, namespace)  # noqa: S102\n    return namespace[\"draw_image\"]()\n\n\n# ── Step 1: og-image.png ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"Asking Claude to draw og-image (1200×630) ...\")\nog_code = ask_claude_for_pillow_code(\n    f\"A 1200×630 px social media preview card for '{{SITE_NAME}}', a queer nightclub in {{VENUE_CITY}}. \"\n    f\"Dark background ({BRAND['bg']}). \"\n    f\"A thin rectangular border frame in accent red ({BRAND['accent']}, opacity ~40%) inset 60 px from each edge. \"\n    f\"Small red dots at the four inner corners of the frame. \"\n    f\"Centered text 'KUDT' in a large bold monospace font (~160 px), color {BRAND['text']}. \"\n    f\"A horizontal red line ({BRAND['accent']}) below the wordmark. \"\n    f\"Smaller text 'PARTY IN A QUEER SPACE' centered below the line (~18 px, {BRAND['text']}, letter-spaced). \"\n    f\"Even smaller text 'ALKMAAR · EST. {{SITE_EST}} · CLUB{{SITE_SHORT}}.NL' centered below that (~13 px, opacity 35%). \"\n    f\"Use ImageFont.load_default() if system fonts are unavailable.\"\n)\n(ROOT / \"_og_image_code.py\").write_text(og_code, encoding=\"utf-8\")\nog_img = run_draw_code(og_code)\nog_img.save(ROOT / \"og-image.png\", format=\"PNG\")\nprint(\"  OK og-image.png (1200×630)\")\n\n\n# ── Step 2: favicon.ico ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"Asking Claude to draw favicon (32×32) ...\")\nfav_code = ask_claude_for_pillow_code(\n    f\"A 32×32 px favicon. Near-black background ({BRAND['bg']}). \"\n    f\"A single bold letter 'K' centered, cream color ({BRAND['text']}), as large as fits. \"\n    f\"A thin horizontal red line ({BRAND['accent']}) below the letter. \"\n    f\"Use ImageFont.load_default() if system fonts are unavailable.\"\n)\n(ROOT / \"_favicon_code.py\").write_text(fav_code, encoding=\"utf-8\")\nfav_img = run_draw_code(fav_code).convert(\"RGBA\")\n\n# Pack multi-size ICO\nsizes = [16, 32, 48]\nico_frames = [fav_img.resize((s, s), Image.LANCZOS) for s in sizes]\nico_frames[0].save(\n    ROOT / \"favicon.ico\",\n    format=\"ICO\",\n    sizes=[(s, s) for s in sizes],\n    append_images=ico_frames[1:],\n)\nprint(f\"  OK favicon.ico ({', '.join(str(s) for s in sizes)} px)\")\n\n\n# ── Step 3: apple-touch-icon.png ─────────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"Asking Claude to draw apple-touch-icon (180×180) ...\")\ntouch_code = ask_claude_for_pillow_code(\n    f\"A 180×180 px iOS home-screen icon. Near-black background ({BRAND['bg']}). \"\n    f\"Centered bold text 'KUDT' in a large monospace font (~52 px), cream color ({BRAND['text']}). \"\n    f\"A thin horizontal red line ({BRAND['accent']}) below the text. \"\n    f\"Looks clean and bold at 60×60 display size. \"\n    f\"Use ImageFont.load_default() if system fonts are unavailable.\"\n)\n(ROOT / \"_touch_icon_code.py\").write_text(touch_code, encoding=\"utf-8\")\ntouch_img = run_draw_code(touch_code).convert(\"RGBA\")\ntouch_img.save(ROOT / \"apple-touch-icon.png\", format=\"PNG\")\nprint(\"  OK apple-touch-icon.png (180×180)\")\n\nprint(\"\\nDone — three image files written to project root.\")\nprint(\"(Intermediate _*_code.py files saved for inspection — safe to delete.)\")\n"
  },

  {
    "name": "studio-build.md",
    "group": "Commands & Skills",
    "path": "commands/studio-build.md",
    "content": "---\ndescription: Build a site from a brand-config.json downloaded from the Design Studio\nargument-hint: \"[path/to/brand-config.json]\"\n---\n\n# /studio-build — Build Site from Design Studio Config\n\nTakes a `brand-config.json` produced by `projects/design-studio/index.html` and\nscaffolds a complete static website into `projects//`.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- After downloading a config from the Design Studio\n- Re-building / updating an existing project after changing brand values\n- Automating the design → site pipeline end-to-end\n\n## Steps\n\n### 1 — Locate brand-config.json\n\nIf the user passed a path argument, use it. Otherwise look in these locations (first match wins):\n\n1. `./brand-config.json`\n2. `~/Downloads/brand-config.json`\n3. Ask the user for the path\n\nRead and parse the file. Validate it has at minimum: `site.name`, `site.short`, `colors`, `venue`.\n\n### 2 — Derive project name\n\n```js\nconst projectName = config.site.name\n  .toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '');\n```\n\nConfirm the output directory with the user: `projects//`\n\n### 3 — Write brand.config.json to project dir\n\n```bash\nmkdir -p projects/\ncp  projects//brand.config.json\n```\n\n### 4 — Scaffold the site\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/scaffold.js \\\n  --config projects//brand.config.json \\\n  --out projects/\n```\n\n### 5 — Font tokens (handled automatically by scaffold)\n\nThe Design Studio config includes a `fonts` object (`{ heading, body }`).\n`scaffold.js` maps these to `{{FONT_HEADING}}`, `{{FONT_BODY}}`, and\n`{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}` — the Google Fonts `` tag is injected into every\npage automatically. No extra step needed.\n\nIf `cfg.fonts` is absent (legacy configs), the tokens fall back to\n`system-ui, sans-serif` and the Google Fonts link is omitted.\n\n### 6 — Apply section flags\n\nThe Design Studio config includes a `sections` map. Pages whose flag is `false` should be\nremoved from the output directory and their nav links cleaned up:\n\n```js\nconst pages = { index:'index.html', events:'events.html', about:'about.html', gallery:'gallery.html', contact:'contact.html' };\nfor (const [key, file] of Object.entries(pages)) {\n  if (!config.sections?.[key]) {\n    // remove file, remove its  from nav in remaining pages\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 7 — Validate output\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/validate.js --dir projects/\n```\n\nFix any remaining `{{TOKEN}}` placeholders before continuing.\n\n### 8 — Generate brand assets\n\n```bash\ncd projects/ && python generate-assets.py\n```\n\nProduces `og-image.png`, `favicon.ico`, and `apple-touch-icon.png` from brand colors.\n\n### 9 — Report\n\nTell the user:\n\n- Output directory: `projects//`\n- Pages generated (list)\n- Any manual content slots still needed:\n  - Event names, dates, ticket URLs (`index.html`, `events.html`)\n  - Team bios (`about.html`)\n  - Gallery / Flickr URL (`gallery.html`)\n  - Google Maps iframe (`contact.html`)\n  - Formspree keys if placeholders remain\n- Next step: open `projects//index.html` in a browser to review\n\n### 10 — Offer session handoff\n\nAfter the report, ask the user:\n\n> \"Want me to save session state so you can pick this up in a new session?\n> Just say yes and I'll run `/save-session` with everything pre-filled.\"\n\nIf the user agrees, invoke `/save-session` with context pre-populated:\n\n- **What's being built**: `projects//` — static site scaffolded from Design Studio config\n- **Current state**: Scaffold complete. Pages: [list generated pages]. Brand assets: generated or pending.\n- **What not to retry**: Do not re-run scaffold without editing `brand-config.json` first — it overwrites output.\n- **What still needs manual content**: [same list from Step 9 — events, bios, gallery URL, map embed, form keys]\n- **Exact next step**: Open `projects//index.html` and fill in [first empty slot].\n- **Environment notes**: Config lives at `projects//brand.config.json`. Re-run `/studio-build projects//brand.config.json` to rebuild after any config edits.\n\nIn a future session, `/resume-session` will load this state and Claude will brief the project before the user types anything.\n\n### 11 — Offer chelp next step\n\nAfter the session handoff offer, prompt:\n\n> Your site is ready at `projects//index.html`.\n>\n> What next?\n> - `/c3` — Design polish (animations, responsive breakpoints, hover states, micro-interactions)\n> - `/c4` — Production hardening (security headers, CSP, performance audit, PR)\n> - `/c5` — Cleanup and docs sync (unused files, README, deployment guide)\n> - Done for now\n\nRun the chosen chain with the project slug and `projects//` as the working context.\nPass the `brand.config.json` path so the chain has access to brand values without re-reading the scaffold.\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n```\n/studio-build\n/studio-build ~/Downloads/brand-config.json\n/studio-build projects/my-club/brand-config.json\n```\n"
  },
  {
    "name": "site-init.md",
    "group": "Commands & Skills",
    "path": "commands/site-init.md",
    "content": "---\ndescription: Scaffold a new site from the queer-nightclub template using a brand config\nargument-hint: \"[project-name] [--config path/to/brand.config.json]\"\n---\n\n# site-init — Scaffold a New Site from Template\n\nGenerates a complete static website by applying a `brand.config.json` to the\n`templates/queer-nightclub/` template. All brand tokens are substituted; the result\nis a production-ready site in `projects//`.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Starting a new nightlife / venue / event brand site\n- Re-skinning the Club KUDT template for a different identity\n- Quickly spinning up a site scaffold before design iteration (then run /c3)\n\n## Steps\n\n### 1 — Gather brand config values\n\nIf the user hasn't provided a `brand.config.json`, ask them interactively for:\n\n| Field | Example |\n|-------|---------|\n| Site name | Club Nacht |\n| Short name (used as logo wordmark) | NACHT |\n| Domain | clubnacht.nl |\n| Tagline | Underground · Electronic · Queer |\n| Description (meta) | One-liner for SEO and social previews |\n| Language code | nl / en / de |\n| Locale | nl_NL / en_GB |\n| Est. year | 2024 |\n| BPM (footer flavor text) | 128 BPM |\n| Background color | #0A0A0A |\n| Text/cream color | #F0EDE6 |\n| Accent color | #7B2FBE |\n| Surface color | #181818 |\n| Muted color | #7A7070 |\n| Venue name | Shelter Amsterdam |\n| Venue city | Amsterdam |\n| Venue region | Noord-Holland |\n| Venue country code | NL |\n| Instagram URL | https://www.instagram.com/clubnacht/ |\n| RA profile URL | https://ra.co/clubs/clubnacht |\n| Form backend | `php` or `formspree` |\n| Formspree newsletter key | (if formspree) |\n| Formspree contact key | (if formspree) |\n| Recipient email | (if php) hello@clubnacht.nl |\n| Ticket URL | https://… |\n\n### 2 — Write brand.config.json\n\nWrite the collected values to `projects//brand.config.json`.\nUse `templates/queer-nightclub/brand.config.json` as the schema reference.\n\n### 3 — Scaffold\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/scaffold.js \\\n  --config projects//brand.config.json \\\n  --out projects/\n```\n\n### 4 — Validate\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/validate.js --dir projects/\n```\n\nFix any remaining `{{TOKEN}}` errors before proceeding.\n\n### 5 — Generate brand assets\n\n```bash\ncd projects/ && python generate-assets.py\n```\n\nThis produces `og-image.png`, `favicon.ico`, and `apple-touch-icon.png` using the\nbrand colors from `brand.config.json`.\n\n### 6 — Remind user of manual content slots\n\nAfter scaffolding, tell the user which content they still need to fill in:\n\n- **Event data**: event names, dates, ticket URLs in `index.html` and `events.html`\n- **Team bios**: real names and roles in `about.html` — Team section\n- **Gallery**: Flickr album URL in `gallery.html`\n- **Map embed**: Google Maps iframe in `contact.html`\n- **Formspree keys** (if using Formspree): replace placeholder keys with real account keys\n- **PHP recipient email** (if using PHP backend): confirm `brand.config.json` recipientEmail\n\n### 7 — Optional: Run /c3 for design polish\n\nOnce content is in place, run `/c3` to tune animations, responsive layout, and visual hierarchy.\n\n## Form Backend Notes\n\n### Formspree (default, easiest)\nSet `\"backend\": \"formspree\"` in brand.config.json.\nSign up at formspree.io, create two forms (newsletter + contact), paste the keys.\nNo server-side code needed.\n\n### PHP (self-hosted, no third-party)\nSet `\"backend\": \"php\"` in brand.config.json and provide `recipientEmail`.\n`form-handler.php` is included in the scaffold output.\nWorks on Hostinger and any host with PHP mail() enabled.\nUpload alongside the HTML files — no extra config needed.\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n```\n/site-init clubnacht\n/site-init my-new-venue --config /tmp/my-brand.json\n```\n"
  },
  {
    "name": "site-template.md",
    "group": "Commands & Skills",
    "path": "skills/site-template.md",
    "content": "---\nname: site-template\ndescription: Queer nightclub static site template — brand config, token substitution, scaffold workflow, and PHP/Formspree form backends\ntriggers:\n  - templates/queer-nightclub/\n  - brand.config.json\n  - scripts/site-template/\n---\n\n# Site Template — Queer Nightclub\n\n## When to Use\n\nAuto-activates when working on files in `templates/queer-nightclub/`, `brand.config.json`,\nor `scripts/site-template/`. Use when:\n\n- Creating a new site from the template\n- Adding a new brand token to the template\n- Debugging scaffold or validate output\n- Switching form backend (Formspree ↔ PHP)\n\n## How It Works\n\n```\nprojects/design-studio/index.html  ← paste reviews, images, social, pick modules\n      │ (Download brand-config.json)\n      ▼\nbrand.config.json\n      │\n      ▼\nscaffold.js  ──reads──▶  templates/queer-nightclub/*.html\n      │                  (token placeholders: {{TOKEN}})\n      ▼\nprojects//         ← fully substituted, production-ready\n      │\n      ├── validate.js    ← confirms no {{TOKEN}} left\n      └── generate-assets.py ← produces og-image.png, favicon.ico\n```\n\n## Token Reference\n\n### Core site tokens\n\n| Token | Config path | Example |\n|-------|-------------|---------|\n| `{{SITE_NAME}}` | `site.name` | Club KUDT |\n| `{{SITE_SHORT}}` | `site.short` | KUDT |\n| `{{SITE_DOMAIN}}` | `site.domain` | clubkudt.nl |\n| `{{SITE_TAGLINE}}` | `site.tagline` | Party in a Queer Space |\n| `{{SITE_DESCRIPTION}}` | `site.description` | Meta description |\n| `{{SITE_LANG}}` | `site.lang` | nl |\n| `{{SITE_LOCALE}}` | #F5F0E8 |\n| `{{COLOR_ACCENT}}` | `colors.accent` | #E8415A |\n| `{{COLOR_SURFACE}}` | `colors.surface` | #1A1A1A |\n| `{{COLOR_MUTED}}` | `colors.muted` | #888070 |\n| `{{VENUE_NAME}}` | `venue.name` | Podium Victorie |\n| `{{VENUE_CITY}}` | `venue.city` | Alkmaar |\n| `{{VENUE_REGION}}` | `venue.region` | Noord-Holland |\n| `{{VENUE_COUNTRY}}` | `venue.country` | NL |\n| `{{SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM}}` | `social.instagram` | https://instagram.com/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_RA}}` | `social.ra` | https://ra.co/clubs/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_FACEBOOK}}` | `social.facebook` | https://facebook.com/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_TIKTOK}}` `{{FORMS_RECIPIENT_EMAIL}}` | `forms.recipientEmail` | hello@… |\n| `{{TICKET_URL}}` | `ticketUrl` | https://… |\n\n### Font tokens\n\n| Token | Config path | Fallback |\n|-------|-------------|---------|\n| `{{FONT_HEADING}}` | `fonts.heading` | `system-ui, sans-serif` |\n| `{{FONT_BODY}}` | `fonts.body` | `system-ui, sans-serif` |\n| `{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}` | `fonts.heading` + `fonts.body` | `''` (omitted) |\n\n`{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}` expands to a `` tag for Google Fonts, or empty string when no fonts are configured.\n\n### Section display tokens\n\nSection tokens resolve to `''` (visible) or `'display:none'` (hidden) for use in `style=\"{{TOKEN}}\"`.\n\n| Token | Controls |\n|-------|---------|\n| `{{SECTION_EVENTS}}` / `{{NAV_EVENTS}}` | Events page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_ABOUT}}` / `{{NAV_ABOUT}}` | About page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_GALLERY}}` / `{{NAV_GALLERY}}` | Gallery page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_CONTACT}}` / `{{NAV_CONTACT}}` | Contact page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_HERO}}` | Hero block on home page |\n| `{{SECTION_NEXT_EVENT}}` | Next-event block on home page |\n| `{{SECTION_NEWSLETTER}}` | Newsletter signup section |\n| `{{SECTION_INSTAGRAM}}` | Instagram CTA section |\n| `{{SECTION_MANIFESTO}}` | Manifesto section |\n| `{{FOOTER_SOCIAL}}` | Footer social links block |\n| `{{FOOTER_NAV}}` | Footer nav links block |\n| `{{FOOTER_BPM}}` | Footer BPM badge |\n\nPages where `sections. === false` are **not written** to the output directory at all.\n\n### Content tokens\n\n| Token | Config path | Notes |\n|-------|-------------|-------|\n| `{{REVIEWS_JSON}}` | `reviews[]` | JSON array — `[{author,text,rating,source}]` |\n| `{{IMAGE_HERO}}` | `images.hero` | URL for hero background-image |\n| `{{IMAGE_OG}}` | `images.og` | URL for OG share image |\n| `{{IMAGE_GALLERY_LIST}}` | `images.gallery[]` | Comma-separated URLs |\n\n### Module system\n\nModules toggle features on/off. Each module token resolves to `''` (visible) or `'display:none'` (hidden).\n\n| Token | Config path | Notes |\n|-------|-------------|-------|\n| `{{MODULE_CALENDAR}}` | `modules.calendar.enabled` | RA embed block on events page |\n| `{{MODULE_CALENDAR_TYPE}}` | `modules.calendar.type` | `ra-embed` \\| `custom` |\n| `{{MODULE_CHECKOUT}}` | `modules.checkout.enabled` | Buy-tickets button block |\n| `{{MODULE_CHECKOUT_URL}}` | `modules.checkout.url` | Stripe link or custom URL |\n| `{{MODULE_PLANNER}}` | `modules.planner.enabled` | Booking request form on contact page |\n| `{{MODULE_GALLERY_TYPE}}` | `modules.gallery.type` | `flickr` \\| `grid` |\n\nModules default to `display:none` when the `modules` key is absent (backwards-compatible).\n\n## Adding a New Token\n\n1. Add the value to `brand.config.json` schema\n2. Add the `{{TOKEN}}` → config mapping to `buildTokenMap()` in `scripts/site-template/scaffold.js`\n3. Place `{{TOKEN}}` in the relevant template file(s) under `templates/queer-nightclub/`\n4. Run `node scripts/site-template/scaffold.js` and `validate.js` to confirm\n\n## Form Backends\n\n### Formspree (default)\n- Set `\"backend\": \"formspree\"` in config\n- Forms POST to `https://formspree.io/f/`\n- No server required — works on any static host\n\n### PHP\n- Set `\"backend\": \"php\"` and provide `recipientEmail`\n- Forms POST to `form-handler.php` (included in scaffold output)\n- Requires PHP with `mail()` enabled (Hostinger, most shared hosts)\n- Includes: honeypot check, per-IP rate limiting (30 s), input sanitization, CORS origin lock\n\n## Quick Commands\n\n```bash\n# Scaffold a new site\nnode scripts/site-template/scaffold.js --config projects/my-club/brand.config.json --out projects/my-club\n\n# Validate no tokens missed\nnode scripts/site-template/validate.js --dir projects/my-club\n\n# Run tests\nnode tests/site-template/scaffold.test.js\n```\n\n## Files\n\n| Path | Purpose |\n|------|---------|\n| `projects/design-studio/index.html` | Browser-based brand config builder |\n| `projects/design-studio/USAGE.md` | Design Studio usage guide |\n\n## Google Reviews Parser\n\nThe Design Studio browser     "content": "# Design Studio — Usage Guide\n\nA browser-based brand builder that generates a `brand-config.json` you can feed\ndirectly into the site scaffolder via `/studio-build`.\n\n## Quick Start\n\n```\nopen projects/design-studio/index.html   # macOS\nxdg-open projects/design-studio/index.html  # Linux\nstart projects/design-studio/index.html  # Windows\n```\n\nOr open the file in any browser — no server needed.\n\n## Workflow\n\n```\n1. Open projects/design-studio/index.html\n        ↓\n2. Fill in Brand tab  (name, tagline, venue, social links)\n        ↓\n3. Pick Colors tab    (use a preset or dial in custom hex values)\n        ↓\n4. Choose Type tab    (heading font + body font)\n        ↓\n5. Toggle Sections    (choose which pages and home sections to include)\n        ↓\n6. Click \"⬇ Download Config\"\n        ↓   saves brand-config.json to ~/Downloads/\n7. In Claude Code, run:  /studio-build\n        ↓\n8. Site lands in  projects//\n```\n\n## Panel Tabs\n\n### Brand\n\n| Field | Notes |\n|-------|-------|\n| Site Name | Full name — used in `` and footer |\n| Short Name | Wordmark / logo text (e.g. `KUDT`) |\n| Tagline | Hero subtitle and meta description fallback |\n| Meta Description | SEO one-liner for search and social |\n| Domain | Used in canonical URLs and JSON-LD |\n| Language Code | `en`, `nl`, `de`, `fr`, `es` |\n| Est. Year | Displayed in hero and footer |\n| BPM | Flavor text in footer — any string works |\n| Venue fields | Structured data for Google rich results |\n| Social URLs | Instagram and Resident Advisor links |\n| Ticket URL | CTA button in hero section |\n| Form Backend | `formspree` (recommended) or `php` |\n| Formspree Keys | Sign up at formspree.io for free keys |\n\n### Colors\n\nFive semantic color tokens:\n\n| Token | Role |\n|-------|------|\n| Background (Void) | Page background |\n| Text / Cream | Body text and headings |\n| Accent | Buttons, links, highlights |\n| Surface | Nav, cards, footer bg |\n| Muted | Subtitles, borders, metadata |\n\nSix built-in presets: **Void Dark**, **Dusk Purple**, **Deep Ocean**,\n**Ember**, **Jade Night**, **Quartz** (light mode).\n\nYou can also type any hex value directly — the color picker and hex field\nstay in sync.\n\n### Type\n\nChoose independent heading and body fonts from six Google Fonts options:\n\n- **Syne** — geometric, editorial\n- **Unbounded** — wide, bold, techno\n- **Playfair Display** — elegant serif\n- **Space Grotesk** — clean, modern\n- **Inter** — neutral, readable\n- **DM Sans** — friendly grotesque\n\n### Sections\n\nToggle which pages and home sections to generate. Pages that are off are\nremoved from the scaffold output and their nav links are cleaned up automatically.\n\n**Modules** — Optional features that can be toggled:\n- **Calendar** — Event listing via RA embed or custom list\n- **Gallery** — Flickr embed or image grid\n- **Newsletter** — Email signup form\n- **Checkout** — Stripe payment link or custom URL\n- **Planner** — Booking request form\n\n### Content (NEW)\n\nAdd user-generated content to your site:\n\n| Section | Purpose |\n|---------|---------|\n| **Google Reviews** | Paste raw reviews from Google Maps or submit as JSON. The parser extracts author, rating, and text automatically. |\n| **Images** | Hero background image URL (large, full-width), OG social share image, and gallery image URLs (one per line). |\n\nReviews appear on the home page with star ratings. Images are applied via background-image or `<img>` tags as appropriate.\n\n## brand-config.json Format\n\n```json\n{\n  \"site\": {\n    \"name\": \"Club Nacht\",\n    \"short\": \"NACHT\",\n    \"domain\": \"clubnacht.nl\",\n    \"tagline\": \"Underground · Electronic · Queer\",\n    \"description\": \"...\",\n    \"lang\": \"nl\",\n    \"locale\": \"nl_NL\",\n    \"estYear\": \"2024\",\n    \"bpm\": \"128 BPM\"\n  },\n  \"colors\": {\n    \"void\": \"#0A0714\",\n    \"cream\": \"#EDE8F5\",\n    \"accent\": \"#9B5CF6\",\n    \"surface\": \"#160D24\",\n    \"muted\": \"#8070A0\"\n  },\n  \"fonts\": {\n    \"heading\": \"Syne\",\n    \"body\": \"Inter\"\n  },\n  \"venue\": {\n    \"name\": \"Shelter Amsterdam\",\n    \"city\": \"Amsterdam\",\n    \"region\": \"Noord-Holland\",\n    \"country\": \"NL\"\n  },\n  \"social\": {\n    \"instagram\": \"https://instagram.com/yourclub\",\n    \"ra\": \"https://ra.co/clubs/yourclub\",\n    \"facebook\": \"https://facebook.com/yourclub\",\n    \"tiktok\": \"https://tiktok.com/@yourclub\",\n    \"spotify\": \"https://open.spotify.com/user/yourclub\",\n    \"youtube\": \"https://youtube.com/@yourclub\"\n  },\n  \"forms\": {\n    \"backend\": \"formspree\",\n    \"newsletterKey\": \"...\",\n    \"contactKey\": \"...\",\n    \"recipientEmail\": \"\"\n  },\n  \"ticketUrl\": \"https://...\",\n  \"sections\": {\n    \"index\": true,\n    \"events\": true,\n    \"about\": true,\n    \"gallery\": true,\n    \"contact\": true,\n    \"hero\": true,\n    \"next-event\": true,\n    \"newsletter\": true,\n    \"instagram\": true,\n    \"manifesto\": false,\n    \"footer-social\": true,\n    \"footer-nav\": true,\n    \"footer-bpm\": true\n  },\n  \"reviews\": [\n    {\n      \"author\": \"Google User\",\n      \"text\": \"Amazing night! Great music and vibe.\",\n      \"rating\": 5,\n      \"source\": \"google\"\n    }\n  ],\n  \"images\": {\n    \"hero\": \"https://...\",\n    \"og\": \"https://...\",\n    \"gallery\": [\"https://...\", \"https://...\"]\n  },\n  \"modules\": {\n    \"calendar\": {\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"type\": \"ra-embed\"\n    },\n    \"checkout\": {\n      \"enabled\": false,\n      \"url\": \"https://buy.stripe.com/...\",\n      \"provider\": \"stripe-link\"\n    },\n    \"planner\": {\n      \"enabled\": false\n    },\n    \"gallery\": {\n      \"enabled\": true,\n      \"type\": \"flickr\"\n    },\n    \"newsletter\": {\n      \"enabled\": true\n    }\n  }\n}\n```\n\n## After `/studio-build`\n\nThe `/studio-build` command scaffolds your site and reports which content slots still need manual editing:\n\n### Automated slots (pre-filled from config)\n- ✅ Reviews — injected from `reviews[]`\n- ✅ Social links — drawn from `social.*` \n- ✅ Hero image — applied from `images.hero`\n- ✅ Modules — calendar, checkout, planner visibility based on `modules.*`\n\n### Manual slots (still need editing)\n- **Event data** — event names, dates, ticket links in `index.html` and `events.html`\n- **Team bios** — names, roles, photos in `about.html`\n- **Gallery** — Flickr album URL (if module enabled) in `gallery.html`\n- **Map embed** — Google Maps iframe in `contact.html` (if contact form enabled)\n- **Formspree keys** — replace placeholder keys with your real account keys from formspree.io\n\n### Next steps\n\n1. Open `projects/<your-site>/index.html` in a browser\n2. Fill in any remaining manual content slots\n3. Run `/c3` for design polish (animations, responsive layout, hover states)\n4. Run `/c4` for production hardening (CSP headers, performance audit)\n5. Deploy to your host (see **Deployment Guide** section below)\n\n## Deployment Guide\n\n### Static hosting (recommended)\n\nYour generated site is a **static site** — just HTML, CSS, JS, and images. No server needed.\n\n**Recommended hosts:**\n- **Vercel** — free tier, automatic deploys from git\n- **Netlify** — free tier, drag-and-drop or git\n- **GitHub Pages** — free, built into GitHub\n- **Render** — free tier, easy setup\n\n**Steps:**\n1. Create a git repo: `git init projects/<your-site>`\n2. Connect to GitHub and push: `git add . && git commit && git push -u origin main`\n3. Connect your repo to Vercel/Netlify in their dashboard\n4. Site deploys automatically on each push\n\n### With PHP form handling\n\nIf you chose `\"backend\": \"php\"` in the Design Studio, you'll need a host with PHP support:\n\n- **Hostinger** — $3/mo, includes PHP + unlimited emails\n- **Bluehost** — $2.95/mo intro, PHP + cPanel\n- **DreamHost** — $2.59/mo, PHP + unlimited databases\n\nUpload the entire `projects/<your-site>/` folder via FTP or their file manager.\n\n### Custom domain\n\nPoint your domain registrar's DNS to your host:\n- **Vercel**: Add CNAME record → vercel.com (see your project settings)\n- **Netlify**: Add CNAME record → your-site.netlify.app\n- **GitHub Pages**: Add CNAME file + DNS CNAME record\n- **PHP host**: Add A record to host's IP address\n\n### Form emails\n\nIf using **Formspree**, emails go directly to your configured `recipientEmail`. No server config needed.\n\nIf using **PHP**, emails are sent from your server. Make sure:\n1. Replace `xkokywzz` and `xrerjzlo` with real Formspree keys, OR\n2. Keep the PHP backend and update `recipientEmail` to your email address\n\n### SSL/HTTPS\n\nModern hosts (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages) include **free SSL certificates** by default.\n\nFor PHP hosts, enable free SSL via your control panel (Let's Encrypt).\n\n## Tips\n\n- Use **Reset** to start over without refreshing the page\n- The live preview updates instantly — no save needed\n- The preview uses the same fonts and colors your generated site will use\n- Font choices are injected as Google Fonts `<link>` tags at scaffold time\n- You can re-run `/studio-build` after editing `brand-config.json` directly\n"
  },

    "content": "'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst path = require('path');\n\nconst TEMPLATE_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../templates/queer-nightclub');\n\nfunction usage() {\n  console.error('Usage: node scaffold.js --config <brand.config.json> --out <output-dir>');\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\n  const args = {};\n  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {\n    if (argv[i] === '--config') args.config = argv[++i];\n    if (argv[i] === '--out') args.out = argv[++i];\n  }\n  return args;\n}\n\nfunction sectionFlag(cfg, key) {\n  return cfg.sections && cfg.sections[key] === false ? '',\n    '{{SOCIAL_RA}}': social.ra || '',\n    // Social (extended)\n    '{{SOCIAL_FACEBOOK}}': social.facebook || '',\n    '{{SOCIAL_TIKTOK}}': social.tiktok || '',\n    '{{SOCIAL_SPOTIFY}}': '<\\\\/script>'),\n\n    // Images\n    '{{IMAGE_HERO}}': images.hero || '',\n    '{{IMAGE_OG}}': images.og || '',\n    '{{IMAGE_GALLERY_LIST}}': (images.gallery || []).join(','),\n\n    // Modules\n    '{{MODULE_CALENDAR}}': moduleFlag(cfg, 'calendar'),\n    '{{MODULE_CALENDAR_TYPE}}': (modules.calendar && modules.calendar.type) || 'ra-embed',\n    '{{MODULE_CHECKOUT}}': moduleFlag(cfg, 'checkout'),\n    '{{MODULE_CHECKOUT_URL}}': (modules.checkout && modules.checkout.url) || '',\n    '{{MODULE_PLANNER}}': moduleFlag(cfg, 'planner'),\n    '{{MODULE_GALLERY_TYPE}}': (modules.gallery && modules.gallery.type) || 'flickr',\n    '{{MODULE_NEWSLETTER}}': moduleFlag(cfg, 'newsletter') || '', // newsletter defaults on\n\n    // SEO (Phase 13.6)\n    '{{SEO_TITLE}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.title) || cfg.site.name,\n    '{{SEO_DESCRIPTION}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.description) || cfg.site.description,\n    '{{SEO_OG_TITLE}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.ogTitle) || cfg.site.name,\n    '{{SEO_KEYWORDS}}': (cfg.seo && cfg.seo.keywords) || '',\n\n    // Layout variants (C2)\n    '{{LAYOUT_HERO}}':       (cfg.layout && cfg.layout.hero)      || 'full-bleed',\n    '{{LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT}}': (cfg.layout && cfg.layout.nextEvent) || 'card',\n    '{{LAYOUT_FOOTER}}':     (cfg.layout && cfg.layout.footer)    || 'standard',\n  };\n}\n\nfunction applyTokens(content, tokenMap) {\n  let result = content;\n  for (const [token, value] of Object.entries(tokenMap)) {\n    result = result.split(token).join(value);\n  }\n  return result;\n}\n\nfunction walkFiles(dir, base = dir, acc = []) {\n  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {\n    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);\n    if (entry.isDirectory()) {\n      walkFiles(full, base, acc);\n    } else {\n      acc.push(path.relative(base, full));\n    }\n  }\n  return acc;\n}\n\nconst BINARY_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['.ico', '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.gif', '.webp', '.woff', '.woff2', '.ttf', '.eot', '.svg']);\n\nfunction isBinary(filePath) {\n  return BINARY_EXTENSIONS.has(path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase());\n}\n\nfunction validateConfig(cfg) {\n  const required = ['site.name', 'site.domain', 'colors.accent', 'venue.city', 'forms.backend'];\n  const missing = required.filter(p => {\n    const [a, b] = p.split('.');\n    return !cfg[a] || !cfg[a][b];\n  });\n  if (missing.length) {\n    console.error(`[scaffold] Config missing required fields: ${missing.join(', ')}`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction scaffold(configPath, outDir) {\n  if (!fs.existsSync(configPath)) {\n    console.error('[scaffold] Config file not found');\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  let cfg;\n  try {\n    cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8'));\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(`[scaffold] Invalid JSON in config: ${e.message}`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  validateConfig(cfg);\n  const tokenMap = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n\n  fs.mkdirSync(outDir, { recursive: true });\n\n  const files = walkFiles(TEMPLATE_DIR);\n  let count = 0;\n\n  // Pages that can be disabled via sections config\n  const PAGE_SECTION_MAP = {\n    'events.html': 'events',\n    'about.html': 'about',\n    'gallery.html': 'gallery',\n    'contact.html': 'contact',\n  };\n\n  for (const rel of files) {\n    // Skip brand.config.json itself — user provides their own\n    if (rel === 'brand.config.json') continue;\n\n    // Skip disabled pages\n    const sectionKey = PAGE_SECTION_MAP[rel];\n    if (sectionKey && cfg.sections && cfg.sections[sectionKey] === false) continue;\n\n    const src = path.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, rel);\n    const dest = path.join(outDir, rel);\n    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true });\n\n    if (isBinary(rel)) {\n      fs.copyFileSync(src, dest);\n    } else {\n      const raw = fs.readFileSync(src, 'utf8');\n      fs.writeFileSync(dest, applyTokens(raw, tokenMap), 'utf8');\n    }\n    count++;\n  }\n\n  // Copy brand.config.json into output so the site remembers its config\n  fs.copyFileSync(configPath, path.join(outDir, 'brand.config.json'));\n\n  console.log(`[scaffold] ${count} files written to ${outDir}`);\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) {\n  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));\n  if (!args.config || !args.out) usage();\n  scaffold(path.resolve(args.config), path.resolve(args.out));\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { scaffold, buildTokenMap, applyTokens };\n"
