    "name": "validate.js",
    "group": "Studio App",
    "path": "scripts/site-template/validate.js",
    "content": "'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst path = require('path');\n\nfunction usage() {\n  console.error('Usage: node validate.js --dir <output-dir> [--config <brand.config.json>]');\n  process.exit(1);\n}\n\nfunction parseArgs(argv) {\n  const args = {};\n  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i++) {\n    if (argv[i] === '--dir') args.dir = argv[++i];\n    if (argv[i] === '--config') args.config = argv[++i];\n  }\n  return args;\n}\n\nconst TEXT_EXTENSIONS = new Set(['.html', '.css', '.js', '.xml', '.txt', '.md', '.json', '.py', '.htaccess', '.php']);\n\nfunction isTextFile(filePath) {\n  const ext = path.extname(filePath).toLowerCase();\n  if (ext === '') {\n    // e.g. .htaccess\n    return path.basename(filePath).startsWith('.');\n  }\n  return TEXT_EXTENSIONS.has(ext);\n}\n\nfunction walkFiles(dir, base = dir, acc = []) {\n  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {\n    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);\n    if (entry.isDirectory()) {\n      walkFiles(full, base, acc);\n    } else {\n      acc.push(path.relative(base, full));\n    }\n  }\n  return acc;\n}\n\nfunction validate(outDir, configPath) {\n  if (!fs.existsSync(outDir)) {\n    console.error(`[validate] Output dir not found: ${outDir}`);\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  const errors = [];\n  const warnings = [];\n  const files = walkFiles(outDir);\n\n  for (const rel of files) {\n    const full = path.join(outDir, rel);\n    if (!isTextFile(rel)) continue;\n\n    const lines = fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8').split('\\n');\n    lines.forEach((line, i) => {\n      // Check for unsubstituted tokens\n      const tokenMatch = line.match(/\\{\\{[A-Z_]+\\}\\}/g);\n      if (tokenMatch) {\n        for (const token of tokenMatch) {\n          errors.push(`${rel}:${i + 1} — unsubstituted token: ${token}`);\n        }\n      }\n    });\n  }\n\n  // If a config was provided, also warn about any source brand strings still in output\n  if (configPath && fs.existsSync(configPath)) {\n    let cfg;\n    try {\n      cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8'));\n    } catch (_) {\n      cfg = null;\n    }\n\n    if (cfg) {\n      // Build a list of source brand values to warn on (skip generic ones like colors)\n      const sourceStrings = [\n        { value: cfg.site.domain, label: 'source domain' },\n        { value: cfg.site.name, label: 'source site name' },\n        { value: cfg.site.short, label: 'source short name' },\n      ].filter(s => s.value && s.value.length > 3);\n\n      const templateConfigPath = path.join(outDir, 'brand.config.json');\n      let outputCfg = null;\n      if (fs.existsSync(templateConfigPath)) {\n        try { outputCfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(templateConfigPath, 'utf8')); } catch (_) {}\n      }\n\n      // Only warn if the output brand differs from the source (i.e. user actually renamed)\n      if (outputCfg && outputCfg.site && outputCfg.site.domain !== cfg.site.domain) {\n        for (const { value, label } of sourceStrings) {\n          for (const rel of files) {\n            if (rel === 'brand.config.json') continue;\n            const full = path.join(outDir, rel);\n            if (!isTextFile(rel)) continue;\n            const content = fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8');\n            if (content.includes(value)) {\n              warnings.push(`${rel} — still contains ${label}: \"${value}\"`);\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (warnings.length) {\n    console.warn('[validate] Warnings:');\n    warnings.forEach(w => console.warn(`  ⚠  ${w}`));\n  }\n\n  if (errors.length) {\n    console.error('[validate] Errors:');\n    errors.forEach(e => console.error(`  ✗  ${e}`));\n    process.exit(1);\n  }\n\n  console.log(`[validate] ✓ ${files.length} files checked — no unsubstituted tokens`);\n}\n\nif (require.main === module) {\n  const args = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));\n  if (!args.dir) usage();\n  validate(path.resolve(args.dir), args.config ? path.resolve(args.config) : null);\n}\n\nmodule.exports = { validate };\n"
  },

    "name": "scaffold.test.js",
    "group": "Studio App",
    "path": "tests/site-template/scaffold.test.js",
    "content": "'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst os = require('os');\nconst path = require('path');\nconst { scaffold, buildTokenMap, applyTokens } = require('../../scripts/site-template/scaffold');\nconst { validate } = require('../../scripts/site-template/validate');\n\nconst TEMPLATE_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../templates/queer-nightclub');\nconst EXAMPLE_CONFIG = path.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, 'brand.config.json');\n\nlet passed = 0;\nlet failed = 0;\n\nfunction test(name, fn) {\n  try {\n    fn();\n    console.log(`  ✓ ${name}`);\n    passed++;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(`  ✗ ${name}`);\n    console.error(`    ${e.message}`);\n    failed++;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction assert(cond, msg) {\n  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg || 'assertion failed');\n}\n\nfunction tmpDir() {\n  return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ecc-scaffold-'));\n}\n\nfunction cleanTmp(dir) {\n  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n}\n\n// ── buildTokenMap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== buildTokenMap ===\\n');\n\ntest('produces expected tokens from config', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{SITE_NAME}}'] === cfg.site.name, 'SITE_NAME mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{SITE_DOMAIN}}'] === cfg.site.domain, 'SITE_DOMAIN mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{COLOR_ACCENT}}'] === cfg.colors.accent, 'COLOR_ACCENT mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{VENUE_CITY}}'] === cfg.venue.city, 'VENUE_CITY mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM}}'] === cfg.social.instagram, 'SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{FORMS_BACKEND}}'] === cfg.forms.backend, 'FORMS_BACKEND mismatch');\n  assert(map['{{TICKET_URL}}'] === cfg.ticketUrl, 'TICKET_URL mismatch');\n});\n\ntest('all tokens map to strings (required tokens non-empty)', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  const required = ['{{SITE_NAME}}', '{{SITE_DOMAIN}}', '{{COLOR_ACCENT}}', '{{VENUE_CITY}}', '{{FORMS_BACKEND}}'];\n  for (const [token, value] of Object.entries(map)) {\n    assert(typeof value === 'string', `${token} is not a string`);\n  }\n  for (const token of required) {\n    assert(map[token] && map[token].length > 0, `required ${token} maps to empty string`);\n  }\n});\n\n// ── applyTokens ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== applyTokens ===\\n');\n\ntest('substitutes a single token', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('Hello {{SITE_NAME}}!', { '{{SITE_NAME}}': 'Club Test' });\n  assert(result === 'Hello Club Test!', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('substitutes multiple occurrences of the same token', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('{{SITE_NAME}} / {{SITE_NAME}}', { '{{SITE_NAME}}': 'X' });\n  assert(result === 'X / X', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('substitutes multiple different tokens', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('{{A}} and {{B}}', { '{{A}}': 'foo', '{{B}}': 'bar' });\n  assert(result === 'foo and bar', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('returns content unchanged when no tokens present', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('no tokens here', { '{{SITE_NAME}}': 'X' });\n  assert(result === 'no tokens here', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('handles empty token map', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('{{SITE_NAME}}', {});\n  assert(result === '{{SITE_NAME}}', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\n// ── scaffold ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== scaffold (integration) ===\\n');\n\ntest('scaffold creates output directory and files', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const files = fs.readdirSync(out);\n    assert(files.length > 0, 'no files written');\n    assert(files.includes('index.html'), 'index.html missing');\n    assert(files.includes('about.html'), 'about.html missing');\n    assert(files.includes('brand.config.json'), 'brand.config.json not copied to output');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('scaffold output contains no unsubstituted {{TOKEN}} in HTML files', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const htmlFiles = fs.readdirSync(out).filter(f => f.endsWith('.html'));\n    for (const file of htmlFiles) {\n      const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, file), 'utf8');\n      const tokens = content.match(/\\{\\{[A-Z_]+\\}\\}/g);\n      assert(!tokens, `${file} still has tokens: ${(tokens || []).join(', ')}`);\n    }\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('scaffold substitutes SITE_NAME throughout', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    const idx = fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, 'index.html'), 'utf8');\n    assert(idx.includes(cfg.site.name), `${cfg.site.name} not found in index.html`);\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('scaffold substitutes accent color in HTML', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    const idx = fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, 'index.html'), 'utf8');\n    assert(idx.includes(cfg.colors.accent), `accent color ${cfg.colors.accent} not found`);\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('scaffold with renamed brand produces no original brand strings in HTML', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  const cfgPath = path.join(out, 'test-brand.json');\n  try {\n    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });\n    const base = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    base.site.name = 'Club Test';\n    base.site.short = 'TEST';\n    base.site.domain = 'clubtest.nl';\n    fs.writeFileSync(cfgPath, JSON.stringify(base), 'utf8');\n    scaffold(cfgPath, out);\n    const htmlFiles = fs.readdirSync(out).filter(f => f.endsWith('.html'));\n    for (const file of htmlFiles) {\n      const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, file), 'utf8');\n      assert(!content.includes('CLUB KUDT'), `${file} still has CLUB KUDT`);\n      assert(!content.includes('clubkudt.nl'), `${file} still has clubkudt.nl`);\n    }\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('scaffold copies brand.config.json into output', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const copied = path.join(out, 'brand.config.json');\n    assert(fs.existsSync(copied), 'brand.config.json not in output');\n    const original = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    const copy = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(copied, 'utf8'));\n    assert(copy.site.name === original.site.name, 'brand.config.json content mismatch');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\n// ── validate ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== validate ===\\n');\n\ntest('validate passes on clean scaffold output', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    // validate should not throw or exit — we capture by not crashing\n    let caught = null;\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (e) { caught = e; }\n    assert(!caught, `validate threw: ${caught}`);\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate catches remaining {{TOKEN}} in a file', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    // Inject a fake token\n    const idx = path.join(out, 'index.html');\n    fs.appendFileSync(idx, '\\n<!-- {{LEFTOVER_TOKEN}} -->');\n    let exited = false;\n    const origExit = process.exit;\n    process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (_) {}\n    process.exit = origExit;\n    assert(exited, 'validate did not call process.exit on leftover token');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\n// ── new token groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== new tokens (fonts, sections, reviews, modules) ===\\n');\n\ntest('font tokens use configured values', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.fonts = { heading: 'Syne', body: 'Inter' };\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{FONT_HEADING}}'] === 'Syne', `FONT_HEADING: ${map['{{FONT_HEADING}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{FONT_BODY}}'] === 'Inter', `FONT_BODY: ${map['{{FONT_BODY}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}'].includes('fonts.googleapis.com'), 'FONT_GOOGLE_LINK missing googleapis');\n  assert(map['{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}'].includes('Syne'), 'FONT_GOOGLE_LINK missing Syne');\n});\n\ntest('font tokens fall back to system-ui when fonts absent', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  delete cfg.fonts;\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{FONT_HEADING}}'].includes('system-ui'), `FONT_HEADING fallback: ${map['{{FONT_HEADING}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{FONT_BODY}}'].includes('system-ui'), `FONT_BODY fallback: ${map['{{FONT_BODY}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}'] === '', 'FONT_GOOGLE_LINK should be empty when no fonts');\n});\n\ntest('section flags return display:none for disabled sections', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.sections = { gallery: false, newsletter: true };\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{SECTION_GALLERY}}'] === 'display:none', `SECTION_GALLERY: ${map['{{SECTION_GALLERY}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{SECTION_NEWSLETTER}}'] === '', `SECTION_NEWSLETTER: ${map['{{SECTION_NEWSLETTER}}']}`);\n});\n\ntest('section flags default to empty string when sections key absent', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  delete cfg.sections;\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{SECTION_EVENTS}}'] === '', `SECTION_EVENTS should default empty: ${map['{{SECTION_EVENTS}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{SECTION_GALLERY}}'] === '', `SECTION_GALLERY should default empty: ${map['{{SECTION_GALLERY}}']}`);\n});\n\ntest('scaffold skips pages whose section flag is false', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  const cfgPath = path.join(out, 'cfg.json');\n  try {\n    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });\n    const base = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    base.sections = { gallery: false };\n    fs.writeFileSync(cfgPath, JSON.stringify(base), 'utf8');\n    scaffold(cfgPath, out);\n    assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(out, 'gallery.html')), 'gallery.html should be skipped');\n    assert(fs.existsSync(path.join(out, 'index.html')), 'index.html should still exist');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('reviews token serialises array as JSON', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.reviews = [{ author: 'Test', text: 'Great night', rating: 5, source: 'google' }];\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  const parsed = JSON.parse(map['{{REVIEWS_JSON}}']);\n  assert(Array.isArray(parsed), 'REVIEWS_JSON is not an array');\n  assert(parsed[0].author === 'Test', 'review author mismatch');\n});\n\ntest('reviews token is empty array JSON when reviews absent', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  delete cfg.reviews;\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{REVIEWS_JSON}}'] === '[]', `REVIEWS_JSON: ${map['{{REVIEWS_JSON}}']}`);\n});\n\ntest('module enabled returns empty string flag', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.modules = { calendar: { enabled: true, type: 'ra-embed' } };\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{MODULE_CALENDAR}}'] === '', `MODULE_CALENDAR enabled should be '': ${map['{{MODULE_CALENDAR}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{MODULE_CALENDAR_TYPE}}'] === 'ra-embed', `MODULE_CALENDAR_TYPE: ${map['{{MODULE_CALENDAR_TYPE}}']}`);\n});\n\ntest('module disabled returns display:none flag', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.modules = { checkout: { enabled: false, url: 'https://buy.stripe.com/test' } };\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{MODULE_CHECKOUT}}'] === 'display:none', `MODULE_CHECKOUT: ${map['{{MODULE_CHECKOUT}}']}`);\n});\n\ntest('module tokens absent when modules key missing', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  delete cfg.modules;\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{MODULE_CALENDAR}}'] === 'display:none', 'MODULE_CALENDAR should default to hidden');\n  assert(map['{{MODULE_PLANNER}}'] === 'display:none', 'MODULE_PLANNER should default to hidden');\n});\n\n// ── layout tokens ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== layout tokens ===\\n');\n\ntest('layout tokens use configured values', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.layout = { hero: 'split', nextEvent: 'banner', footer: 'minimal' };\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{LAYOUT_HERO}}'] === 'split', `LAYOUT_HERO: ${map['{{LAYOUT_HERO}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT}}'] === 'banner', `LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT: ${map['{{LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{LAYOUT_FOOTER}}'] === 'minimal', `LAYOUT_FOOTER: ${map['{{LAYOUT_FOOTER}}']}`);\n});\n\ntest('layout tokens fall back to defaults when layout key absent', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  delete cfg.layout;\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(map['{{LAYOUT_HERO}}'] === 'full-bleed', `LAYOUT_HERO default: ${map['{{LAYOUT_HERO}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT}}'] === 'card', `LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT default: ${map['{{LAYOUT_NEXT_EVENT}}']}`);\n  assert(map['{{LAYOUT_FOOTER}}'] === 'standard', `LAYOUT_FOOTER default: ${map['{{LAYOUT_FOOTER}}']}`);\n});\n\ntest('scaffold output contains no unsubstituted LAYOUT tokens', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const idx = fs.readFileSync(path.join(out, 'index.html'), 'utf8');\n    assert(!idx.includes('{{LAYOUT_'), 'No {{LAYOUT_ tokens remain in index.html');\n  } finally {\n    fs.rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });\n  }\n});\n\n// ── error handling ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== error handling ===\\n');\n\ntest('scaffold exits on missing config file', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    let exited = false;\n    const origExit = process.exit;\n    process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n    try { scaffold('/nonexistent/brand-config.json', out); } catch (_) {}\n    process.exit = origExit;\n    assert(exited, 'process.exit not called for missing config');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('scaffold exits on invalid JSON in config', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  const cfgPath = path.join(out, 'bad.json');\n  try {\n    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });\n    fs.writeFileSync(cfgPath, '{ not valid json }', 'utf8');\n    let exited = false;\n    const origExit = process.exit;\n    process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n    try { scaffold(cfgPath, out); } catch (_) {}\n    process.exit = origExit;\n    assert(exited, 'process.exit not called for invalid JSON');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('scaffold handles config with all optional keys absent', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  const cfgPath = path.join(out, 'minimal.json');\n  try {\n    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });\n    const base = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    delete base.fonts;\n    delete base.sections;\n    delete base.reviews;\n    delete base.images;\n    delete base.modules;\n    delete base.layout;\n    delete base.seo;\n    fs.writeFileSync(cfgPath, JSON.stringify(base), 'utf8');\n    scaffold(cfgPath, out);\n    assert(fs.existsSync(path.join(out, 'index.html')), 'index.html missing with minimal config');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('applyTokens handles token value containing $ (no regex substitution)', () => {\n  const result = applyTokens('{{A}}', { '{{A}}': '$100' });\n  assert(result === '$100', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('applyTokens with two-token map substitutes all tokens sequentially', () => {\n  // Each token in the map is applied once in sequence\n  // If {{A}} → {{B}} and {{B}} → 'replaced', {{A}} becomes 'replaced' because {{B}} is also in the map\n  const result = applyTokens('{{A}} {{B}}', { '{{A}}': '{{B}}', '{{B}}': 'replaced' });\n  assert(result === 'replaced replaced', `got: ${result}`);\n});\n\ntest('buildTokenMap with unicode site name produces valid string tokens', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.site.name = '클럽 테스트 🎵';\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(typeof map['{{SITE_NAME}}'] === 'string', 'SITE_NAME not a string');\n  assert(map['{{SITE_NAME}}'] === '클럽 테스트 🎵', 'SITE_NAME mismatch');\n});\n\ntest('REVIEWS_JSON token escapes </script> tags to prevent injection', () => {\n  const cfg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n  cfg.reviews = [{ author: 'Test', text: '</script><script>alert(1)</script>', rating: 5, source: 'google' }];\n  const map = buildTokenMap(cfg);\n  assert(!map['{{REVIEWS_JSON}}'].includes('</script>'), 'unescaped </script> found in REVIEWS_JSON');\n  assert(map['{{REVIEWS_JSON}}'].includes('<\\\\/script>'), 'escaped form not found in REVIEWS_JSON');\n});\n\ntest('scaffold with all non-index pages disabled still creates index.html', () => {\n base.sections = { index: true, events: false, about: false, gallery: false, contact: false,\n      hero: true, 'next-event': true, newsletter: true, instagram: true, manifesto: false,\n      'footer-social': true, 'footer-nav': true, 'footer-bpm': true };\n    fs.writeFileSync(cfgPath, JSON.stringify(base), 'utf8');\n    scaffold(cfgPath, out);\n    assert(fs.existsSync(path.join(out, 'index.html')), 'index.html missing when other pages disabled');\n    assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(out, 'events.html')), 'events.html should not exist');\n    assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(out, 'gallery.html')), 'gallery.html should not exist');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\n// ── Results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log(`\\n=== Test Results ===`);\nconsole.log(`Passed: ${passed}`);\nconsole.log(`Failed: ${failed}`);\nconsole.log(`Total:     "name": "validate.test.js",
    "group": "Studio App",
    "path": "tests/site-template/validate.test.js",
    "content": "'use strict';\n\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst os = require('os');\nconst path = require('path');\nconst { scaffold } = require('../../scripts/site-template/scaffold');\nconst { validate } = require('../../scripts/site-template/validate');\n\nconst TEMPLATE_DIR = path.resolve(__dirname, '../../templates/queer-nightclub');\nconst EXAMPLE_CONFIG = path.join(TEMPLATE_DIR, 'brand.config.json');\n\nlet passed = 0;\nlet failed = 0;\n\nfunction test(name, fn) {\n  try {\n    fn();\n    console.log(`  ✓ ${name}`);\n    passed++;\n  } catch (e) {\n    console.error(`  ✗ ${name}`);\n    console.error(`    ${e.message}`);\n    failed++;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction assert(cond, msg) {\n  if (!cond) throw new Error(msg || 'assertion failed');\n}\n\nfunction tmpDir() {\n  return fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'ecc-validate-'));\n}\n\nfunction cleanTmp(dir) {\n  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });\n}\n\nconsole.log('\\n=== validate ===\\n');\n\ntest('validate passes on clean scaffold output', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    let caught = null;\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (e) { caught = e; }\n    assert(!caught, `validate threw: ${caught}`);\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate catches {{LEFTOVER_TOKEN}} in HTML and calls process.exit', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    const idx = path.join(out, 'index.html');\n    fs.appendFileSync(idx, '\\n<!-- {{LEFTOVER_TOKEN}} -->');\n    let exited = false;\n    const origExit = process.exit;\n    process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (_) {}\n    process.exit = origExit;\n    assert(exited, 'validate did not call process.exit on leftover token');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate warns when original brand string remains after rename', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  const altCfgPath = path.join(out, 'alt-brand.json');\n  try {\n    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });\n    // Build a renamed config so the output brand differs from source\n    const base = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, 'utf8'));\n    base.site.name = 'New Club';\n    base.site.short = 'NEW';\n    base.site.domain = 'newclub.nl';\n    fs.writeFileSync(altCfgPath, JSON.stringify(base), 'utf8');\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out); // scaffold with ORIGINAL config — source brand strings will appear\n    // validate against alt config — domain differs, should trigger brand string check\n    let warnFired = false;\n    const origWarn = console.warn;\n    console.warn = (msg) => { if (msg && msg.includes('source')) warnFired = true; origWarn(msg); };\n    let caught = null;\n    try { validate(out, altCfgPath); } catch (e) { caught = e; }\n    console.warn = origWarn;\n    // Should either warn or pass — main assertion is no crash\n    assert(!caught || caught.message === 'exit called', `unexpected error: ${caught}`);\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate skips binary files (.ico, .png)', () => {\n  const out = tmpDir();\n  try {\n    scaffold(EXAMPLE_CONFIG, out);\n    // Inject a fake token into a binary-extension file — validate should not catch it\n    const fake = path.join(out, 'fake.ico');\n    fs.writeFileSync(fake, '{{FAKE_TOKEN}}');\n    let exited = false;\n    const origExit = process.exit;\n    process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n    try { validate(out, null); } catch (_) {}\n    process.exit = origExit;\n    assert(!exited, 'validate scanned binary .ico file and exited unexpectedly');\n  } finally {\n    cleanTmp(out);\n  }\n});\n\ntest('validate handles missing output directory by calling process.exit', () => {\n  let exited = false;\n  const origExit = process.exit;\n  process.exit = () => { exited = true; throw new Error('exit called'); };\n  try { validate('/nonexistent/output-dir', null); } catch (_) {}\n  process.exit = origExit;\n  assert(exited, 'validate did not call process.exit for missing output dir');\n});\n\n// ── Results ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconsole.log(`\\n=== Test Results ===`);\nconsole.log(`Passed: ${passed}`);\nconsole.log(`Failed: ${failed}`);\nconsole.log(`Total:  ${passed + failed}`);\n\nif (failed > 0) process.exit(1);\n"
  },

mode=block\"\n\n  # Force HTTPS for 1 year, include subdomains\n  Header always set Strict-Transport-Security \"max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload\"\n\n  # Control referrer information sent to third parties\n  Header always set Referrer-Policy \"strict-origin-when-cross-origin\"\n\n  # Permissions Policy — disable unused browser APIs\n  Header always set Permissions-Policy \"camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=()\"\n\n  # Content Security Policy\n  # Allows: self, GSAP CDN (cdnjs), Google Fonts, Formspree, RA/Spotify embeds\n  Header always set Content-Security-Policy \"default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://fonts.googleapis.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://formspree.io; frame-src https://ra.co https://open.spotify.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self' https://formspree.io;\"\n\n\n# Disable directory listing\nOptions -Indexes\n\n# Deny access to hidden files (e.g. .htaccess itself)\n\n  Order allow,deny\n  Deny from all\n\n\n# Deny access to Python utility scripts (not public assets)\n\n  Order allow,deny\n  Deny from all\n\n\n# Compression\n\n  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css application/javascript application/json\n\n\n# Cache static assets aggressively; bust cache via filename versioning when assets change\n\n  ExpiresActive On\n  ExpiresByType image/png \"access plus 1 year\"\n  ExpiresByType image/svg+xml \"access plus 1 year\"\n  ExpiresByType image/x-icon \"access plus 1 year\"\n  ExpiresByType text/css \"access plus 1 month\"\n  ExpiresByType application/javascript \"access plus 1 month\"\n  ExpiresByType text/html \"access plus 1 hour\"\n\n\n# Custom 404\nErrorDocument 404 /404.html\n"

    "name": "template/form-handler.php",

    "path": "templates/queer-nightclub/form-handler.php",
    "content": " 'forbidden']);\n}\nheader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: ' . $origin);\nheader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST');\n\n// ── Only POST ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {\n    json_out(405, ['error' => 'method not allowed']);\n}\n\n// ── Parse body ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n$body = [];\n$ct   = $_SERVER['CONTENT_TYPE'] ?? '';\nif (str_contains($ct, 'application/json')) {\n    $body = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];\n} else {\n    $body = $_POST;\n}\n\n$type = sanitize($body['_type'] ?? 'newsletter');\n\n// ── Honeypot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif (!empty($body['_gotcha'])) {\n    json_out(200, ['ok' => true]); // silent absorb\n}\n\n// ── Newsletter signup ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif ($type === 'newsletter') {\n    $email = sanitize($body['email'] ?? '');\n    if (!validate_email($email)) {\n        json_out(422, ['error' => 'invalid email']);\n    }\n    $ip_key = 'nl_' . ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? 'x');\n    if (!rate_check($ip_key)) {\n        json_out(429, ['error' => 'too many requests']);\n    }\n\n    $to      = RECIPIENT;\n    $subject = SITE_NAME . ' — New newsletter signup';\n    $message = \"New newsletter signup from \" . SITE_DOMAIN . \"\\n\\nEmail: {$email}\\nTime: \" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s T');\n    $headers = \"From: no-reply@\" . SITE_DOMAIN . \"\\r\\nReply-To: {$email}\\r\\nX-Mailer: PHP/\" . phpversion();\n\n    $sent = mail($to, $subject, $message, $headers);\n    json_out($sent ? 200 : 500, $sent ? ['ok' => true] : ['error' => 'mail failed']);\n}\n\n// ── Contact / booking form ──────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nif ($type === 'contact') {\n    $name    = sanitize($body['name']    ?? '');\n    $email   = sanitize($body['email']   ?? '');\n    $subject = sanitize($body['subject'] ?? 'Enquiry');\n    $message = sanitize($body['message'] ?? '');\n\n    if (!$name || !validate_email($email) || !$message) {\n        json_out(422, ['error' => 'missing required fields']);\n    }\n    if (strlen($message) > 4000) {\n        json_out(422, ['error' => 'message too long']);\n    }\n\n    $ip_key = 'contact_' . ($_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? 'x');\n    if (!rate_check($ip_key)) {\n        json_out(429, ['error' => 'too many requests']);\n    }\n\n    $to       = RECIPIENT;\n    $sub      = SITE_NAME . \" — {$subject} from {$name}\";\n    $body_txt = \"Name: {$name}\\nEmail: {$email}\\nSubject: {$subject}\\n\\n{$message}\\n\\nSent from: \" . SITE_DOMAIN;\n    $headers  = \"From: no-reply@\" . SITE_DOMAIN . \"\\r\\nReply-To: {$email}\\r\\nX-Mailer: PHP/\" . phpversion();\n\n    $sent = mail($to, $sub, $body_txt, $headers);\n    json_out($sent ? 200 : 500, $sent ? ['ok' => true] : ['error' => 'mail failed']);\n}\n\njson_out(400, ['error' => 'unknown form type']);\n"

    "name": "template/generate-assets.py",
    "group": "Template",
    "path": "templates/queer-nightclub/generate-assets.py",
    "content": "\"\"\"\ngenerate-assets.py\nGenerates og-image.png, favicon.ico, and apple-touch-icon.png for {{SITE_NAME}}.\n\nRequirements:\n    pip install anthropic Pillow\n\nUsage:\n    ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-... python generate-assets.py\n\"\"\"\n\nimport io\nimport os\nimport re\nimport sys\nimport textwrap\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport anthropic\nfrom PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).parent\nAPI_KEY = os.environ.get(\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\")\nif not API_KEY:\n    sys.exit(\"Error: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable is not set.\")\n\nclient = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=API_KEY)\n\nBRAND = {\n    \"bg\": \"#0a0a0a\",\n    \"text\": \"{{COLOR_CREAM}}\",\n    \"accent\": \"{{COLOR_ACCENT}}\",\n    \"muted\": \"{{COLOR_MUTED}}\",\n}\n\n\ndef ask_claude_for_pillow_code(description: str) -> str:\n    prompt = textwrap.dedent(f\"\"\"\n        Write a Python function called `draw_image` that returns a `PIL.Image.Image` object.\n\n        The function must:\n        - Use only `PIL.Image`, `PIL.ImageDraw`, and `PIL.ImageFont` (already imported)\n        - Draw: {description}\n        - Return the finished Image object\n\n        Brand colors: background {BRAND['bg']}, text/shapes {BRAND['text']}, accent {BRAND['accent']}.\n\n        Output ONLY the raw Python function — no markdown fences, no imports, no example calls.\n    \"\"\").strip()\n\n    message = client.messages.create(\n        model=\"claude-sonnet-4-6\",\n        max_tokens=2048,\n        messages=[{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": prompt}],\n    )\n    code = message.content[0].text.strip()\n    # Strip accidental markdown fences\n    code = re.sub(r\"^```[a-z]*\\n?\", \"\", code)\n    code = re.sub(r\"\\n?```$\", \"\", code)\n    return code.strip()\n\n\ndef run_draw_code(code: str) -> Image.Image:\n    import PIL\n    import PIL.Image\n    import PIL.ImageDraw\n    import PIL.ImageFont\n    namespace = {\n        \"PIL\": PIL,\n        \"Image\": Image,\n        \"ImageDraw\": ImageDraw,\n        \"ImageFont\": ImageFont,\n    }\n    exec(code, namespace)  # noqa: S102\n    return namespace[\"draw_image\"]()\n\n\n# ── Step 1: og-image.png ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"Asking Claude to draw og-image (1200×630) ...\")\nog_code = ask_claude_for_pillow_code(\n    f\"A 1200×630 px social media preview card for '{{SITE_NAME}}', a queer nightclub in {{VENUE_CITY}}. \"\n    f\"Dark background ({BRAND['bg']}). \"\n    f\"A thin rectangular border frame in accent red ({BRAND['accent']}, opacity ~40%) inset 60 px from each edge. \"\n    f\"Small red dots at the four inner corners of the frame. \"\n    f\"Centered text 'KUDT' in a large bold monospace font (~160 px), color {BRAND['text']}. \"\n    f\"A horizontal red line ({BRAND['accent']}) below the wordmark. \"\n    f\"Smaller text 'PARTY IN A QUEER SPACE' centered below the line (~18 px, {BRAND['text']}, letter-spaced). \"\n    f\"Even smaller text 'ALKMAAR · EST. {{SITE_EST}} · CLUB{{SITE_SHORT}}.NL' centered below that (~13 px, opacity 35%). \"\n    f\"Use ImageFont.load_default() if system fonts are unavailable.\"\n)\n(ROOT / \"_og_image_code.py\").write_text(og_code, encoding=\"utf-8\")\nog_img = run_draw_code(og_code)\nog_img.save(ROOT / \"og-image.png\", format=\"PNG\")\nprint(\"  OK og-image.png (1200×630)\")\n\n\n# ── Step 2: favicon.ico ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"Asking Claude to draw favicon (32×32) ...\")\nfav_code = ask_claude_for_pillow_code(\n    f\"A 32×32 px favicon. Near-black background ({BRAND['bg']}). \"\n    f\"A single bold letter 'K' centered, cream color ({BRAND['text']}), as large as fits. \"\n    f\"A thin horizontal red line ({BRAND['accent']}) below the letter. \"\n    f\"Use ImageFont.load_default() if system fonts are unavailable.\"\n)\n(ROOT / \"_favicon_code.py\").write_text(fav_code, encoding=\"utf-8\")\nfav_img = run_draw_code(fav_code).convert(\"RGBA\")\n\n# Pack multi-size ICO\nsizes = [16, 32, 48]\nico_frames = [fav_img.resize((s, s), Image.LANCZOS) for s in sizes]\nico_frames[0].save(\n    ROOT / \"favicon.ico\",\n    format=\"ICO\",\n    sizes=[(s, s) for s in sizes],\n    append_images=ico_frames[1:],\n)\nprint(f\"  OK favicon.ico ({', '.join(str(s) for s in sizes)} px)\")\n\n\n# ── Step 3: apple-touch-icon.png ─────────────────────────────────────────────\nprint(\"Asking Claude to draw apple-touch-icon (180×180) ...\")\ntouch_code = ask_claude_for_pillow_code(\n    f\"A 180×180 px iOS home-screen icon. Near-black background ({BRAND['bg']}). \"\n    f\"Centered bold text 'KUDT' in a large monospace font (~52 px), cream color ({BRAND['text']}). \"\n    f\"A thin horizontal red line ({BRAND['accent']}) below the text. \"\n    f\"Looks clean and bold at 60×60 display size. \"\n    f\"Use ImageFont.load_default() if system fonts are unavailable.\"\n)\n(ROOT / \"_touch_icon_code.py\").write_text(touch_code, encoding=\"utf-8\")\ntouch_img = run_draw_code(touch_code).convert(\"RGBA\")\ntouch_img.save(ROOT / \"apple-touch-icon.png\", format=\"PNG\")\nprint(\"  OK apple-touch-icon.png (180×180)\")\n\nprint(\"\\nDone — three image files written to project root.\")\nprint(\"(Intermediate _*_code.py files saved for inspection — safe to delete.)\")\n"

    "name": "studio-build.md",
    "group": "Commands & Skills",
    "path": "commands/studio-build.md",
    "content": "---\ndescription: Build a site from a brand-config.json downloaded from the Design Studio\nargument-hint: \"[path/to/brand-config.json]\"\n---\n\n# /studio-build — Build Site from Design Studio Config\n\nTakes a `brand-config.json` produced by `projects/design-studio/index.html` and\nscaffolds a complete static website into `projects//`.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- After downloading a config from the Design Studio\n- Re-building / updating an existing project after changing brand values\n- Automating the design → site pipeline end-to-end\n\n## Steps\n\n### 1 — Locate brand-config.json\n\nIf the user passed a path argument, use it. Otherwise look in these locations (first match wins):\n\n1. `./brand-config.json`\n2. `~/Downloads/brand-config.json`\n3. Ask the user for the path\n\nRead and parse the file. Validate it has at minimum: `site.name`, `site.short`, `colors`, `venue`.\n\n### 2 — Derive project name\n\n```js\nconst projectName = config.site.name\n  .toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '-').replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, '');\n```\n\nConfirm the output directory with the user: `projects//`\n\n### 3 — Write brand.config.json to project dir\n\n```bash\nmkdir -p projects/\ncp  projects//brand.config.json\n```\n\n### 4 — Scaffold the site\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/scaffold.js \\\n  --config projects//brand.config.json \\\n  --out projects/\n```\n\n### 5 — Font tokens (handled automatically by scaffold)\n\nThe Design Studio config includes a `fonts` object (`{ heading, body }`).\n`scaffold.js` maps these to `{{FONT_HEADING}}`, `{{FONT_BODY}}`, and\n`{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}` — the Google Fonts `` tag is injected into every\npage automatically. No extra step needed.\n\nIf `cfg.fonts` is absent (legacy configs), the tokens fall back to\n`system-ui, sans-serif` and the Google Fonts link is omitted.\n\n### 6 — Apply section flags\n\nThe Design Studio config includes a `sections` map. Pages whose flag is `false` should be\nremoved from the output directory and their nav links cleaned up:\n\n```js\nconst pages = { index:'index.html', events:'events.html', about:'about.html', gallery:'gallery.html', contact:'contact.html' };\nfor (const [key, file] of Object.entries(pages)) {\n  if (!config.sections?.[key]) {\n    // remove file, remove its  from nav in remaining pages\n  }\n}\n```\n\n### 7 — Validate output\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/validate.js --dir projects/\n```\n\nFix any remaining `{{TOKEN}}` placeholders before continuing.\n\n### 8 — Generate brand assets\n\n```bash\ncd projects/ && python generate-assets.py\n```\n\nProduces `og-image.png`, `favicon.ico`, and `apple-touch-icon.png` from brand colors.\n\n### 9 — Report\n\nTell the user:\n\n- Output directory: `projects//`\n- Pages generated (list)\n- Any manual content slots still needed:\n  - Event names, dates, ticket URLs (`index.html`, `events.html`)\n  - Team bios (`about.html`)\n  - Gallery / Flickr URL (`gallery.html`)\n  - Google Maps iframe (`contact.html`)\n  - Formspree keys if placeholders remain\n- Next step: open `projects//index.html` in a browser to review\n\n### 10 — Offer session handoff\n\nAfter the report, ask the user:\n\n> \"Want me to save session state so you can pick this up in a new session?\n> Just say yes and I'll run `/save-session` with everything pre-filled.\"\n\nIf the user agrees, invoke `/save-session` with context pre-populated:\n\n- **What's being built**: `projects//` — static site scaffolded from Design Studio config\n- **Current state**: Scaffold complete. Pages: [list generated pages]. Brand assets: generated or pending.\n- **What not to retry**: Do not re-run scaffold without editing `brand-config.json` first — it overwrites output.\n- **What still needs manual content**: [same list from Step 9 — events, bios, gallery URL, map embed, form keys]\n- **Exact next step**: Open `projects//index.html` and fill in [first empty slot].\n- **Environment notes**: Config lives at `projects//brand.config.json`. Re-run `/studio-build projects//brand.config.json` to rebuild after any config edits.\n\nIn a future session, `/resume-session` will load this state and Claude will brief the project before the user types anything.\n\n### 11 — Offer chelp next step\n\nAfter the session handoff offer, prompt:\n\n> Your site is ready at `projects//index.html`.\n>\n> What next?\n> - `/c3` — Design polish (animations, responsive breakpoints, hover states, micro-interactions)\n> - `/c4` — Production hardening (security headers, CSP, performance audit, PR)\n> - `/c5` — Cleanup and docs sync (unused files, README, deployment guide)\n> - Done for now\n\nRun the chosen chain with the project slug and `projects//` as the working context.\nPass the `brand.config.json` path so the chain has access to brand values without re-reading the scaffold.\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n```\n/studio-build\n/studio-build ~/Downloads/brand-config.json\n/studio-build projects/my-club/brand-config.json\n```\n"
  },

    "content": "---\ndescription: Scaffold a new site from the queer-nightclub template using a brand config\nargument-hint: \"[project-name] [--config path/to/brand.config.json]\"\n---\n\n# site-init — Scaffold a New Site from Template\n\nGenerates a complete static website by applying a `brand.config.json` to the\n`templates/queer-nightclub/` template. All brand tokens are substituted; the result\nis a production-ready site in `projects//`.\n\n## When to Use\n\n- Starting a new nightlife / venue / event brand site\n- Re-skinning the Club KUDT template for a different identity\n- Quickly spinning up a site scaffold before design iteration (then run /c3)\n\n## Steps\n\n### 1 — Gather brand config values\n\nIf the user hasn't provided a `brand.config.json`, ask them interactively for:\n\n| Field | Example |\n|-------|---------|\n| Site name | Club Nacht |\n| Short name (used as logo wordmark) | NACHT |\n| Domain | clubnacht.nl |\n| Tagline | Underground · Electronic · Queer |\n| Description (meta) | One-liner for SEO and social previews |\n| Language code | nl / en / de |\n| Locale | nl_NL / en_GB |\n| Est. year | 2024 |\n| BPM (footer flavor text) | 128 BPM |\n| Background color | #0A0A0A |\n| Text/cream color | #F0EDE6 |\n| Accent color | #7B2FBE |\n| Surface color | #181818 |\n| Muted color | #7A7070 |\n| Venue name | Shelter Amsterdam |\n| Venue city | Amsterdam |\n| Venue region | Noord-Holland |\n| Venue country code | NL |\n| Instagram URL | https://www.instagram.com/clubnacht/ |\n| RA profile URL | https://ra.co/clubs/clubnacht |\n| Form backend | `php` or `formspree` |\n| Formspree newsletter key | (if formspree) |\n| Formspree contact key | (if formspree) |\n| Recipient email | (if php) hello@clubnacht.nl |\n| Ticket URL | https://… |\n\n### 2 — Write brand.config.json\n\nWrite the collected values to `projects//brand.config.json`.\nUse `templates/queer-nightclub/brand.config.json` as the schema reference.\n\n### 3 — Scaffold\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/scaffold.js \\\n  --config projects//brand.config.json \\\n  --out projects/\n```\n\n### 4 — Validate\n\n```bash\nnode scripts/site-template/validate.js --dir projects/\n```\n\nFix any remaining `{{TOKEN}}` errors before proceeding.\n\n### 5 — Generate brand assets\n\n```bash\ncd projects/ && python generate-assets.py\n```\n\nThis produces `og-image.png`, `favicon.ico`, and `apple-touch-icon.png` using the\nbrand colors from `brand.config.json`.\n\n### 6 — Remind user of manual content slots\n\nAfter scaffolding, tell the user which content they still need to fill in:\n\n- **Event data**: event names, dates, ticket URLs in `index.html` and `events.html`\n- **Team bios**: real names and roles in `about.html` — Team section\n- **Gallery**: Flickr album URL in `gallery.html`\n- **Map embed**: Google Maps iframe in `contact.html`\n- **Formspree keys** (if using Formspree): replace placeholder keys with real account keys\n- **PHP recipient email** (if using PHP backend): confirm `brand.config.json` recipientEmail\n\n### 7 — Optional: Run /c3 for design polish\n\nOnce content is in place, run `/c3` to tune animations, responsive layout, and visual hierarchy.\n\n## Form Backend Notes\n\n### Formspree (default, easiest)\nSet `\"backend\": \"formspree\"` in brand.config.json.\nSign up at formspree.io, create two forms (newsletter + contact), paste the keys.\nNo server-side code needed.\n\n### PHP (self-hosted, no third-party)\nSet `\"backend\": \"php\"` in brand.config.json and provide `recipientEmail`.\n`form-handler.php` is included in the scaffold output.\nWorks on Hostinger and any host with PHP mail() enabled.\nUpload alongside the HTML files — no extra config needed.\n\n## Usage Examples\n\n```\n/site-init clubnacht\n/site-init my-new-venue --config /tmp/my-brand.json\n```\n"

    "content": "---\nname: site-template\ndescription: Queer nightclub static site template — brand config, token substitution, scaffold workflow, and PHP/Formspree form backends\ntriggers:\n  - templates/queer-nightclub/\n  - brand.config.json\n  - scripts/site-template/\n---\n\n# Site Template — Queer Nightclub\n\n## When to Use\n\nAuto-activates when working on files in `templates/queer-nightclub/`, `brand.config.json`,\nor `scripts/site-template/`. Use when:\n\n- Creating a new site from the template\n- Adding a new brand token to the template\n- Debugging scaffold or validate output\n- Switching form backend (Formspree ↔ PHP)\n\n## How It Works\n\n```\nprojects/design-studio/index.html  ← paste reviews, images, social, pick modules\n      │ (Download brand-config.json)\n      ▼\nbrand.config.json\n      │\n      ▼\nscaffold.js  ──reads──▶  templates/queer-nightclub/*.html\n      │                  (token placeholders: {{TOKEN}})\n      ▼\nprojects//         ← fully substituted, production-ready\n      │\n      ├── validate.js    ← confirms no {{TOKEN}} left\n      └── generate-assets.py ← produces og-image.png, favicon.ico\n```\n\n## Token Reference\n\n### Core site tokens\n\n| Token | Config path | Example |\n|-------|-------------|---------|\n| `{{SITE_NAME}}` | `site.name` | Club KUDT |\n| `{{SITE_SHORT}}` | `site.short` | KUDT |\n| `{{SITE_DOMAIN}}` | `site.domain` | clubkudt.nl |\n| `{{SITE_TAGLINE}}` | `site.tagline` | Party in a Queer Space |\n| `{{SITE_DESCRIPTION}}` | `site.description` | Meta description |\n| `{{SITE_LANG}}` | `site.lang` | nl |\n| `{{SITE_LOCALE}}` | `site.locale` | nl_NL |\n| `{{SITE_EST}}` | `site.estYear` | 2022 |\n| `{{SITE_BPM}}` | `site.bpm` | 140 BPM |\n| `{{COLOR_VOID}}` | `colors.void` | #0D0D0D |\n| `{{COLOR_CREAM}}` | `colors.cream` | #F5F0E8 |\n| `{{COLOR_ACCENT}}` | `colors.accent` | #E8415A |\n| `{{COLOR_SURFACE}}` | `colors.surface` | #1A1A1A |\n| `{{COLOR_MUTED}}` | `colors.muted` | #888070 |\n| `{{VENUE_NAME}}` | `venue.name` | Podium Victorie |\n| `{{VENUE_CITY}}` | `venue.city` | Alkmaar |\n| `{{VENUE_REGION}}` | `venue.region` | Noord-Holland |\n| `{{VENUE_COUNTRY}}` | `venue.country` | NL |\n| `{{SOCIAL_INSTAGRAM}}` | `social.instagram` | https://instagram.com/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_RA}}` | `social.ra` | https://ra.co/clubs/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_FACEBOOK}}` | `social.facebook` | https://facebook.com/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_TIKTOK}}` | `social.tiktok` | https://tiktok.com/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_SPOTIFY}}` | `social.spotify` | https://open.spotify.com/… |\n| `{{SOCIAL_YOUTUBE}}` | `social.youtube` | https://youtube.com/… |\n| `{{FORMS_BACKEND}}` | `forms.backend` | php \\| formspree |\n| `{{FORMSPREE_NEWSLETTER}}` | `forms.newsletterKey` | xkokywzz |\n| `{{FORMSPREE_CONTACT}}` | `forms.contactKey` | xrerjzlo |\n| `{{FORMS_RECIPIENT_EMAIL}}` | `forms.recipientEmail` | hello@… |\n| `{{TICKET_URL}}` | `ticketUrl` | https://… |\n\n### Font tokens\n\n| Token | Config path | Fallback |\n|-------|-------------|---------|\n| `{{FONT_HEADING}}` | `fonts.heading` | `system-ui, sans-serif` |\n| `{{FONT_BODY}}` | `fonts.body` | `system-ui, sans-serif` |\n| `{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}` | `fonts.heading` + `fonts.body` | `''` (omitted) |\n\n`{{FONT_GOOGLE_LINK}}` expands to a `` tag for Google Fonts, or empty string when no fonts are configured.\n\n### Section display tokens\n\nSection tokens resolve to `''` (visible) or `'display:none'` (hidden) for use in `style=\"{{TOKEN}}\"`.\n\n| Token | Controls |\n|-------|---------|\n| `{{SECTION_EVENTS}}` / `{{NAV_EVENTS}}` | Events page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_ABOUT}}` / `{{NAV_ABOUT}}` | About page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_GALLERY}}` / `{{NAV_GALLERY}}` | Gallery page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_CONTACT}}` / `{{NAV_CONTACT}}` | Contact page + nav link |\n| `{{SECTION_HERO}}` | Hero block on home page |\n| `{{SECTION_NEXT_EVENT}}` | Next-event block on home page |\n| `{{SECTION_NEWSLETTER}}` | Newsletter signup section |\n| `{{SECTION_INSTAGRAM}}` | Instagram CTA section |\n| `{{SECTION_MANIFESTO}}` | Manifesto section |\n| `{{FOOTER_SOCIAL}}` | Footer social links block |\n| `{{FOOTER_NAV}}` | Footer nav links block |\n| `{{FOOTER_BPM}}` | Footer BPM badge |\n\nPages where `sections. === false` are **not written** to the output directory at all.\n\n### Content tokens\n\n| Token | Config path | Notes |\n|-------|-------------|-------|\n| `{{REVIEWS_JSON}}` | `reviews[]` | JSON array — `[{author,text,rating,source}]` |\n| `{{IMAGE_HERO}}` | `images.hero` | URL for hero background-image |\n| `{{IMAGE_OG}}` | `images.og` | URL for OG share image |\n| `{{IMAGE_GALLERY_LIST}}` | `images.gallery[]` | Comma-separated URLs |\n\n### Module system\n\nModules toggle features on/off. Each module token resolves to `''` (visible) or `'display:none'` (hidden).\n\n| Token | Config path | Notes |\n|-------|-------------|-------|\n| `{{MODULE_CALENDAR}}` | `modules.calendar.enabled` | RA embed block on events page |\n| `{{MODULE_CALENDAR_TYPE}}` | `modules.calendar.type` | `ra-embed` \\| `custom` |\n| `{{MODULE_CHECKOUT}}` | `modules.checkout.enabled` | Buy-tickets button block |\n| `{{MODULE_CHECKOUT_URL}}` | `modules.checkout.url` | Stripe link or custom URL |\n| `{{MODULE_PLANNER}}` | `modules.planner.enabled` | Booking request form on contact page |\n| `{{MODULE_GALLERY_TYPE}}` | `modules.gallery.type` | `flickr` \\| `grid` |\n\nModules default to `display:none` when the `modules` key is absent (backwards-compatible).\n\n## Adding a New Token\n\n1. Add the value to `brand.config.json` schema\n2. Add the `{{TOKEN}}` → config mapping to `buildTokenMap()` in `scripts/site-template/scaffold.js`\n3. Place `{{TOKEN}}` in the relevant template file(s) under `templates/queer-nightclub/`\n4. Run `node scripts/site-template/scaffold.js` and `validate.js` to confirm\n\n## Form Backends\n\n### Formspree (default)\n- Set `\"backend\": \"formspree\"` in config\n- Forms POST to `https://formspree.io/f/`\n- No server required — works on any static host\n\n### PHP\n- Set `\"backend\": \"php\"` and provide `recipientEmail`\n- Forms POST to `form-handler.php` (included in scaffold output)\n- Requires PHP with `mail()` enabled (Hostinger, most shared hosts)\n- Includes: honeypot check, per-IP rate limiting (30 s), input sanitization, CORS origin lock\n\n## Quick Commands\n\n```bash\n# Scaffold a new site\nnode scripts/site-template/scaffold.js --config projects/my-club/brand.config.json --out projects/my-club\n\n# Validate no tokens missed\nnode scripts/site-template/validate.js --dir projects/my-club\n\n# Run tests\nnode tests/site-template/scaffold.test.js\n```\n\n## Files\n\n| Path | Purpose |\n|------|---------|\n| `templates/queer-nightclub/brand.config.json` | Example config (Club KUDT values) |\n| `templates/queer-nightclub/*.html` | Token-substituted HTML pages |\n| `templates/queer-nightclub/form-handler.php` | PHP form backend |\n| `scripts/site-template/scaffold.js` | Scaffold engine |\n| `scripts/site-template/validate.js` | Token completeness checker |\n| `tests/site-template/scaffold.test.js` | Test suite |\n| `commands/site-init.md` | `/site-init` slash command |\n| `commands/studio-build.md` | `/studio-build` slash command |\n| `projects/design-studio/index.html` | Browser-based brand config builder |\n| `projects/design-studio/USAGE.md` | Design Studio usage guide |\n\n## Google Reviews Parser\n\nThe Design Studio browser app includes a heuristic parser for pasting raw Google Maps review text.\n\nIt handles two input formats:\n1. **JSON array** — `[{\"author\":\"…\",\"text\":\"…\",\"rating\":5}]` → parsed directly\n2. **Raw text** — multi-line blocks copied from Google Maps:\n   ```\n   Alice\n   5 stars\n   2 reviews\n   Amazing night out!\n   ```\n   The parser extracts name, star count, and review body from each block.\n\nOutput format:\n```json\n[{ \"author\": \"Alice\", \"text\": \"Amazing night out!\", \"rating\": 5, \"source\": \"google\" }]\n```\n\nThe parsed array is serialised as `{{REVIEWS_JSON}}` and injected into `index.html` via:\n```html\n\n```\n"

let _bundleActive = -1;

function initBundleList() {
  if (!window.BUNDLE_FILES || !BUNDLE_FILES.length) {
    document.getElementById('bundle-list').innerHTML =
      '
No files bundled yet.
Run: node scripts/build-bundle.js
';
    return;
  }
  const groups = [...new Set(BUNDLE_FILES.map(f => f.group))];
  let html = '';
  groups.forEach(g => {
    html += `
${g}
`;
    BUNDLE_FILES.forEach((f, i) => {
      if (f.group !== g) return;
      html += ``;
    });
  });
  document.getElementById('bundle-list').innerHTML = html;
}

function showBundleFile(i) {
  _bundleActive = i;
  const f = BUNDLE_FILES[i];
  document.getElementById('bundle-filename').textContent = `${f.path}  (${f.content.split('\n').length} lines)`;
  document.getElementById('bundle-viewer').textContent = f.content;
  document.getElementById('bundle-copy-btn').style.display = '';
  document.getElementById('bundle-dl-btn').style.display = '';
  document.querySelectorAll('.bundle-file-btn').forEach((b, j) => {
    b.style.background = j === i ? 'var(--studio-accent)' : 'none';
    b.style.color = j === i ? '#fff' : 'var(--studio-text)';
  });
}

function copyBundleFile() {
  if (_bundleActive < 0) return;
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(BUNDLE_FILES[_bundleActive].content)
    .then(() => showToast('Copied!'))
    .catch(() => showToast('Copy failed'));
}

function downloadCurrentBundleFile() {
  if (_bundleActive < 0) return;
  const f = BUNDLE_FILES[_bundleActive];
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([f.content], { type: 'text/plain' }));
  a.download = f.name;
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 1000);
}

// Init bundle list when Files tab is first opened
const _origSwitchTab = switchTab;
function switchTab(name) {
  _origSwitchTab(name);
  if (name === 'files' && document.getElementById('bundle-list').innerHTML === '') initBundleList();
}

// ── Init ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
update();
pushHistory(); // seed undo stack with initial state
